class_veteran.description: They came home from the Argonne in 1919 and found work as extras, doormen and Legion boxers. Every one of them swore he was finished with fighting. Now the war has followed them to Hollywood Boulevard, so they dig in, hold the line and show the younger fellows how it's done.
class_veteran.icon: a dented doughboy Brodie helmet over crossed bayonet and trench shovel, lit by a red flare

spec_veteran_0.description: The man who kept his squad alive in the Meuse-Argonne still does it, shield up and voice raised, standing wherever the mandibles land first.
spec_veteran_0.icon: a riveted steel shield bearing sergeant chevrons, green ichor splashing off its face

spec_veteran_1.description: Over the top with a two-handed weapon and no second thoughts. The bayonet charge worked in 1918, and the bugs have not read the field manuals.
spec_veteran_1.icon: a fixed bayonet on a Springfield rifle lunging forward, motion streaks and mud flying

spec_veteran_2.description: Learned at the Legion smokers on Selma Avenue, a weapon in each fist and no bell to save anybody. Queensberry never wrote a rule for beetles.
spec_veteran_2.icon: two taped fists gripping a trench knife and brass knuckles, sparks flying, boxing ring ropes behind

class_powderman.description: Studio effects men who blew up Atlanta twice a week and swept up the cork by supper. They know black powder, flash paper and smoke pots better than their own children. When the hive took the lots, they took the powder magazine with them.
class_powderman.icon: a lit fuse sparking toward a bundle of dynamite sticks, orange glow on black

spec_powderman_0.description: Gasoline, magnesium and a steady match. A Fire man sets the blaze, stands back and lets it eat slow, the way it ate the Babylon set.
spec_powderman_0.icon: a burning road flare dripping molten fire, flames curling upward in smoke

spec_powderman_1.description: Smoke pots made a thousand battlefields on a ten-dollar budget. Now they blind compound eyes, choke the drones and hide a man who needs to be elsewhere.
spec_powderman_1.icon: a battered smoke canister pouring thick grey clouds, insect silhouettes lost within

spec_powderman_2.description: The big charges, wired by hand and touched off from behind a sandbag. Demolition men measure success by how far the windows rattled on Vine.
spec_powderman_2.icon: a T-handle plunger detonator pressed down, shockwave and debris bursting behind it

ab_vet_thrust.description: The same short, ugly lunge they drilled at Camp Kearny, twelve years on. The steel goes in where the shell plates part.
ab_vet_thrust.icon: a bayonet thrusting forward through green insect ichor, motion streaks

ab_vet_shout.description: A voice built for artillery and parade grounds. Men stand straighter, and somewhere a bug three blocks off stops chewing.
ab_vet_shout.icon: an open-mouthed sergeant's face in profile, sound rings bursting outward, campaign hat

ab_vet_hold.description: You plant your boots and make yourself the biggest, loudest, most insulting thing on the street. The bug takes the bait.
ab_vet_hold.icon: a battered steel shield braced against a huge mandible, sparks flying

ab_vet_sweep.description: A wide, flat swing learned in a crowded trench, where the enemy came in threes and nobody had room to be polite.
ab_vet_sweep.icon: a broad steel arc slashing through three insect silhouettes, curved motion trail

ab_vet_butt.description: The Army never wrote it in the manual, but every doughboy knew the wooden end works fine too.
ab_vet_butt.icon: a rifle stock smashing into an insect head, cracked chitin, yellow stars

ab_vet_dig_in.description: Shoulders down, chin tucked, feet in the dirt like the Argonne all over again. Let it come.
ab_vet_dig_in.icon: a helmeted soldier crouched behind sandbags, claws glancing off, dust rising

ab_vet_over_top.description: The whistle blows in your head and you go, the way you went in 1918, and this time you mean to finish it.
ab_vet_over_top.icon: a soldier leaping over a sandbag parapet, bayonet raised, red flare sky

class_mechanic.description: Garage men, studio grips and camera-truck mechanics who kept the lots running on baling wire and bad language. Since the Dome came down they fix what the bugs break, rig what the bugs fear, and swing a sledge at whatever won't stay fixed.
class_mechanic.icon: a heavy steel wrench crossed with a sledgehammer over a glowing spark plug, oil gleaming

spec_mechanic_0.description: Tin-can alarms, spring traps and a motor-driven contraption that spits rivets. If it ticks, whirs or goes off when nobody expected it, a Gadgets man built it in a garage.
spec_mechanic_0.icon: a clockwork rivet turret on a tripod spitting glowing hot rivets, gears whirring

spec_mechanic_1.description: A four-pound sledge, a tire iron, a pipe wrench as long as a man's arm. The insects grow hard shells; the Heavy Tools men bring harder answers.
spec_mechanic_1.icon: a two-handed sledgehammer cracking a green chitin shell, shards and ichor flying

spec_mechanic_2.description: Splints, tourniquets and a canvas kit of patches that work on people about as well as on radiators. Nobody asks where the rubber hose came from.
spec_mechanic_2.icon: an open canvas tool roll glowing warm, bandages and a soldering iron inside

class_gunman.description: Trick shooters from the Wild West shows, Gower Gulch cowboys, game wardens and the men who loaded blanks at Stembridge on Marathon Street. When the bugs came, somebody swapped the blanks for live rounds. Gunmen keep their distance, keep their heads and keep count of the shells.
class_gunman.icon: crossed Winchester rifle and Colt revolver over a brass shell casing, smoke curling, warm gunmetal glow

spec_gunman_0.description: One rifle, one rest, one breath held. Marksmen learned the trade in the Argonne or on the deer runs above Tujunga, and they do not waste a cartridge.
spec_gunman_0.icon: telescopic rifle sight crosshairs centred on a giant compound insect eye, cold blue glint

spec_gunman_1.description: Annie Oakley's heirs, late of the Miller Brothers 101 Ranch show: shooting from the hip, off the mirror, with both hands at once. The bugs never applaud.
spec_gunman_1.icon: twin nickel revolvers fanning fire, a playing card split edgewise by a bullet mid-air

spec_gunman_2.description: Hound men from the canyons and the studio animal pens, working a dog that has learned what a hive smells like. The dog finds them; the gun finishes it.
spec_gunman_2.icon: snarling bloodhound bounding past a smoking shotgun barrel, studded collar, amber dusk light

ab_stn_haymaker.description: Thrown from the hip like the cowboy who started every saloon brawl on the Columbia lot. Wild, wide and telegraphed from Pasadena, and it lands anyway.
ab_stn_haymaker.icon: a bare knuckled fist swinging wide in a hard arc, motion streaks, flying sweat

ab_stn_tumble.description: A shoulder roll learned on a thousand takes. The mandible snaps shut on the spot where you stood a moment ago.
ab_stn_tumble.icon: a stuntman mid-roll on dusty pavement, a giant insect claw striking empty air

ab_stn_low_blow.description: The Production Code forbids it on screen. Nobody under the Dome is filming, and the thing folds up just the same.
ab_stn_low_blow.icon: a boot driving upward into an insect's segmented underbelly, yellow impact flash

ab_stn_flurry.description: Three cuts faster than a newsreel can follow, the kind of work the studios hired you to fake and never knew you could do for real.
ab_stn_flurry.icon: a switchblade leaving three silver slash trails across green chitin

ab_stn_bottle.description: Sugar glass from the prop room, made to shatter harmlessly over a leading man. Nobody told the prop man what gets poured inside it now.
ab_stn_bottle.icon: a breakaway bottle bursting into glittering shards against an insect's legs, sticky splash

ab_stn_leap.description: The same jump that took you off a Gower Street rooftop for two dollars a fall. You come down boots first on everything around you.
ab_stn_leap.icon: a figure plunging from above, boots first, shockwave ring scattering insect shapes

ab_stn_showstopper.description: The finish you saved for the picture that never got made. Somewhere a director would have shouted cut and printed it.
ab_stn_showstopper.icon: a fist and knife striking together under a blazing spotlight, chitin cracking apart

class_nurse.description: They came from Hollywood Hospital, the studio first-aid huts and the base hospitals of France, and they have seen worse than bugs. Now they work double shifts in the Roosevelt lobby and the gutters of Highland Avenue. Nobody on the line argues with a nurse twice.
class_nurse.icon: a starched white nurse's cap with a red cross, glowing softly above a rolled bandage

spec_nurse_0.description: Tag the dying, patch the living, move to the next cot. Triage nurses learned it in France, where the stretchers never stopped coming and neither did they.
spec_nurse_0.icon: a red triage tag tied to a bandaged wrist, a steel surgical clamp gleaming beside it

spec_nurse_1.description: Slow work and sure: carbolic, clean dressings, a spoonful of something bitter on the hour. A good nurse keeps a man mending long after she has left his bedside.
spec_nurse_1.icon: a brown glass medicine bottle with a dropper, warm amber light seeping from within

spec_nurse_2.description: Every hospital dispensary holds enough to kill a horse, and most bugs are smaller than a horse. The nurse measures carefully, then pours generously.
spec_nurse_2.icon: a glass syringe of bubbling green toxin dripping onto a cracked insect carapace

class_stuntman.description: They fell off horses, trains and the roofs of Poverty Row for seven-fifty a day and a bandage. When the bugs took the lots, the men who doubled for the stars found the real fight paid no better and hurt about the same. They hit first and land on their feet.
class_stuntman.icon: a scuffed leather riding boot mid-leap through a shattering breakaway window, glass shards glinting

spec_stuntman_0.description: Saloon brawls were staged with pulled punches. Out here nobody pulls anything, and a man who can throw one for the camera learns fast to throw one for keeps.
spec_stuntman_0.icon: a taped bare-knuckle fist smashing through a breakaway saloon chair, splinters flying

spec_stuntman_1.description: Prop knives were rubber. The ones in a stuntman's boot these days are Sheffield steel, honed nightly and slipped between chitin plates where the hive forgot to armour.
spec_stuntman_1.icon: a boot knife sliding between green chitin plates, a bright glint along the edge

spec_stuntman_2.description: The trick to a forty-foot fall is knowing where the boxes are. The trick with an insect's charge is the same: be somewhere else, and land laughing.
spec_stuntman_2.icon: a figure tumbling backwards off a rooftop toward stacked cardboard boxes, motion blur

class_preacher.description: Tent revivalists, storefront pastors and Angelus Temple choir hands who were saving Hollywood's soul long before anything landed on it. They carry a cane, a worn Bible and a voice that fills five thousand seats. Now they patch up sinners and saints alike, and preach fire at anything with six legs.
class_preacher.icon: a worn leather Bible crossed with a hickory cane, golden light pouring from its open pages

spec_preacher_0.description: Hymns sung loud enough to carry over gunfire. When the whole congregation is bleeding, the Gospel preacher lifts every voice in the room back onto its feet.
spec_preacher_0.icon: an open hymnal radiating warm golden rings of sound over a crowd of upraised palms

spec_preacher_1.description: The dry crusade turned to armour. Temperance preachers stand between the faithful and harm the way they once stood between a thirsty man and his bottle.
spec_preacher_1.icon: a shattered whiskey bottle behind a glowing pale blue shield of light, glass shards frozen midair

spec_preacher_2.description: Sawdust-trail sermons with the brimstone left in. The Hellfire preacher calls down judgment on the hive, and the hive, for once, listens.
spec_preacher_2.icon: a preacher's pointing hand wreathed in roaring orange flame above a scorched, curling insect wing

ab_gun_aimed.description: Breathe out, lay the bead on the joint behind the head, squeeze. The shot that wins the turkey at the county fair, here spent on something with six legs.
ab_gun_aimed.icon: rifle sights aligned on a giant insect's neck joint, muzzle flash blooming bright

ab_gun_hip.description: No sighting, no ceremony. The gun clears leather and speaks before the bug has finished turning around.
ab_gun_hip.icon: revolver fired from the hip, smoke curling, brass casing spinning in the air

ab_gun_knee.description: A round into the leg joint where the shell is thinnest. Even a hive soldier limps when it has one less knee to stand on.
ab_gun_knee.icon: bullet shattering a chitinous insect leg joint, green ichor spraying sideways

ab_gun_fan.description: Palm slapping the hammer, six shots so close together the extras on Gower Street would swear it was one long one.
ab_gun_fan.icon: hand fanning a revolver hammer, six overlapping muzzle flashes in a blur

ab_gun_buckshot.description: A shell of double-ought sprays the whole knot of them. The bugs bunch up like a crowd at a premiere, and pay for it.
ab_gun_buckshot.icon: shotgun blast spreading a cone of pellets into a cluster of insects

ab_gun_nerves.description: The hands stop shaking, the noise goes far away, and every shell joint on the field looks big as a barn door.
ab_gun_nerves.icon: steady gloved hand on a trigger guard, calm blue glow around the knuckles

ab_gun_rights.description: The bug is caught square, nowhere to run, and the gunman takes his time. Some shots end the argument outright.
ab_gun_rights.icon: rifle barrel pressed close to a cornered insect's head, blinding white muzzle flash

class_electrician.description: The juicers who ran cable and trimmed carbon arcs on every sound stage in town. When the hive took the lots, they kept the keys to the powerhouse and learned that a thousand amps cooks a beetle as well as it lights a starlet. Union men, mostly, and still sore about the overtime.
class_electrician.icon: a heavy brass knife switch thrown closed, blue sparks leaping across its copper blades

spec_electrician_0.description: Strike the arc and hold it on one target. The blue-white spark that burns down a carbon rod burns through chitin just as easily, and it does not wander.
spec_electrician_0.icon: a jagged blue-white arc leaping from two carbon rods into a cracked insect carapace

spec_electrician_1.description: A ten-thousand-watt sun on wheels, swung across a whole swarm at once. Things raised in the dark of a hive hate a key light worse than poison.
spec_electrician_1.icon: a big studio floodlight on a stand blazing white beams over silhouetted insects

spec_electrician_2.description: Portable dynamos hauled off the location trucks and wound to throw a crackling skin of current around the crew. Anything that bites through it gets a mouthful.
spec_electrician_2.icon: a humming iron dynamo wrapped in a glowing blue dome of crackling current

ab_elc_arc.description: A blue spark leaps from the wrench tip with a crack like a slapstick. The bug twitches, and the air smells of a stage after a thunderstorm scene.
ab_elc_arc.icon: a blue electric spark leaping from a wrench tip to a green insect leg

ab_elc_insulate.description: Rubber, mica and a prayer, wound round the body the way you'd tape a cable. Claws skid off it like rain off a studio umbrella.
ab_elc_insulate.icon: a faint amber glow of coiled rubber-taped wire wrapping a raised forearm

ab_elc_live_wire.description: A loose cable lashes onto the target and stays there, spitting sparks on a steady count. It hums like a neon sign on Vine.
ab_elc_live_wire.icon: a writhing black cable coiled round an insect thorax, sparks bursting at intervals

ab_elc_floodlight.description: A ten-thousand-watt studio lamp swings round and opens up. Anything caught in the beam cooks like a starlet under the old carbon arcs.
ab_elc_floodlight.icon: a huge studio floodlight blazing white, beam scorching silhouetted insects

ab_elc_short.description: One bad splice, done on purpose. The bug locks rigid with its feelers standing straight up, like an extra who's forgotten his line.
ab_elc_short.icon: a fused junction box exploding in white sparks, a frozen insect antenna above

ab_elc_overload.description: Every breaker on the board thrown at once, the lamp bulbs popping down the line. It takes a moment to build, and the bug never forgets it.
ab_elc_overload.icon: a switchboard glowing red-hot, bulbs bursting, a thick bolt erupting forward

ab_elc_chain.description: The current isn't fussy about who it meets. It jumps from shell to shell down the line like gossip through the Brown Derby.
ab_elc_chain.icon: a forked lightning bolt zigzagging between three insect silhouettes at night

ab_nur_ether.description: A rag soaked from the brown bottle, pressed hard over whatever passes for a face. The fumes do the rest, and the nurse holds her breath.
ab_nur_ether.icon: a white rag dripping clear ether pressed against a mandible, sickly green vapour curling

ab_nur_dress.description: Clean gauze, a firm hand and a safety pin. She has wrapped worse on extras who fell off horses in Gower Gulch.
ab_nur_dress.icon: a roll of white gauze unspooling around a bloodied forearm, warm golden glow

ab_nur_tonic.description: A spoonful of something bitter from an unlabelled bottle. It warms the chest slowly and keeps on working long after the face stops puckering.
ab_nur_tonic.icon: an amber tonic bottle tipping into a silver spoon, soft rising steam of light

ab_nur_salts.description: One sharp whiff under the nose and the fallen sit bolt upright, eyes watering, asking who hit them.
ab_nur_salts.icon: a small glass vial of smelling salts uncorked, sharp white fumes bursting outward

ab_nur_iodine.description: A flung bottle of iodine splashes brown across the carapace and keeps burning. It stings people too, as every child in Los Angeles can tell you.
ab_nur_iodine.icon: a brown iodine bottle shattering against an insect shell, orange-brown splash smoking

ab_nur_surgery.description: Sleeves up, lamp held close, forceps and catgut on a folding table. Not a hospital, but the patient lives to complain about it.
ab_nur_surgery.icon: steel forceps and curved needle trailing catgut above a lamplit wound, bright white glow

ab_nur_sedative.description: A syringe driven in at the soft joint between plates. Even a hive soldier stops to think about that, then stops thinking altogether.
ab_nur_sedative.icon: a glass syringe plunging into an insect leg joint, blue sedative swirling inward

ab_pre_rebuke.description: A finger leveled and a verse from Ezekiel, delivered like a slap. The insect reels as if someone had struck it with the Book itself.
ab_pre_rebuke.icon: a pointing preacher's hand crackling with white-gold light striking an insect mandible

ab_pre_hands.description: Two calloused palms on a bloody shoulder, eyes shut, lips moving. The bleeding slows, the breathing steadies, and nobody asks how.
ab_pre_hands.icon: two weathered hands pressed on a bandaged shoulder, warm golden glow seeping between fingers

ab_pre_blessing.description: A quick sign of the cross and a word over the head. Claws come down and glance off something nobody can see.
ab_pre_blessing.icon: translucent golden halo-dome over a kneeling man, insect claw glancing off in sparks

ab_pre_sermon.description: Brimstone, delivered at full volume in the Angelus Temple style. The words catch on the target like a lit fuse and keep burning.
ab_pre_sermon.icon: open Bible with pages ablaze, orange flames curling toward a writhing insect silhouette

ab_pre_hymn.description: An old Methodist tune, sung loud enough to carry over gunfire. Everyone within earshot stands a little straighter and bleeds a little less.
ab_pre_hymn.icon: a preacher's open mouth singing, golden musical waves rippling outward across rubble

ab_pre_fear.description: The preacher draws himself up and roars Judgment. Even a four-metre hive brute freezes, unsure what just happened to it.
ab_pre_fear.icon: towering preacher shadow over a cowering giant beetle, blinding white light behind him

ab_pre_revival.description: The tent-meeting cure, full fervour and both arms raised. Men who were halfway to Hollywood Cemetery get up and ask for their hats.
ab_pre_revival.icon: a fallen man rising in a pillar of radiant golden light, arms lifted

ab_mec_swing.description: Fourteen inches of drop-forged steel, swung like a man who has stripped a thousand rusted nuts and finally found something that deserves it.
ab_mec_swing.icon: a heavy adjustable wrench mid-swing, motion arc, green ichor flecks spraying off the jaw

ab_mec_patch.description: Friction tape, a dab of axle grease and a clean rag from the back pocket. It held a Model A together; it will hold you.
ab_mec_patch.icon: a roll of black friction tape wound around a bandaged forearm, soft warm glow

ab_mec_caltrops.description: A coffee can of roofing nails and bent bolts flung across the pavement. Six legs or two, nobody crosses that without picking their way.
ab_mec_caltrops.icon: bent nails and jagged bolts scattered across cobblestones, glinting, one spiking a chitinous insect foot

ab_mec_monkey.description: Thrown end over end at the head. Somewhere on the lot a foreman is still asking who walked off with his good wrench.
ab_mec_monkey.icon: a monkey wrench tumbling end over end through the air, cartoon stars bursting on impact

ab_mec_welder.description: The torch spits blue-white fire and molten bead. Studio welders learned to work without goggles the day the bugs came over the wall.
ab_mec_welder.icon: a welding torch blasting a blue-white arc, sparks fanning outward in a burning circle

ab_mec_overhaul.description: Tighten every buckle, hammer the dents flat, bolt a sheet of boiler plate over the bad spot. Ugly work, but it runs.
ab_mec_overhaul.icon: a riveted steel plate being hammered onto a leather jacket, sparks and glowing rivets

ab_mec_pile.description: Both hands, full weight, straight down, the way the gangs drove piling for the Mulholland Dam. Shells crack the same as timber.
ab_mec_pile.icon: a massive two-handed sledgehammer slamming downward, cracked insect carapace and shockwave dust ring

ab_pow_flash.description: A pinch of magnesium in the tray, a thumb on the trigger, and a white bang that would make any newsreel cameraman reach for his hat.
ab_pow_flash.icon: a flash-powder tray erupting in blinding white light, smoke curling, sparks flying outward

ab_pow_fuse.description: The powder man lights it and walks away. The bug never hears the hiss until its shell starts to blister from the inside.
ab_pow_fuse.icon: a lit fuse snaking along the ground, orange sparks crawling toward a scorched insect leg

ab_pow_smoke.description: A tin pot from the effects truck, good for battlefield scenes and burning barns. Insects lose their way in it as badly as extras do.
ab_pow_smoke.icon: a battered tin smoke pot belching thick grey clouds, dim insect silhouettes staggering

ab_pow_squib.description: The little charge they tape under a shirt to make a gunshot look real. Taped to a carapace, it does not need to look like anything.
ab_pow_squib.icon: a small wired squib bursting on green chitin, spray of ichor and paper wadding

ab_pow_keg.description: Black powder, a stout oak keg and a short fuse. In the war they'd have called it excessive; on a studio lot they call it Tuesday.
ab_pow_keg.icon: an oak powder keg exploding outward, staves and orange fire flying in every direction

ab_pow_screen.description: He cracks a canister at his own feet and steps sideways into the grey. Claws close on smoke and come away empty.
ab_pow_screen.icon: a figure in shirtsleeves half-vanished into billowing white smoke, a pincer grasping empty air

ab_pow_demo.description: The charge they save for blowing up a whole set in one take. Studio insurance men would weep; there are none left to ask.
ab_pow_demo.icon: bundled dynamite sticks with plunger detonator, a towering fireball rising behind them

tal_vet_parade_ground.description: Twelve years on, the knees still lock and the chin still lifts when a sergeant's voice carries. The bugs have yet to see you slouch.
tal_vet_parade_ground.icon: polished army boots planted at attention on dusty parade ground, golden morning light

tal_vet_barked_orders.description: You learned to make yourself heard over a barrage at Saint-Mihiel. A few insects clicking in a soundstage are no competition.
tal_vet_barked_orders.icon: open mouth of a shouting sergeant under steel helmet, sound rings rippling outward

tal_vet_sandbagged.description: You stand behind your shield the way you stood behind a sandbag wall in the Argonne: low, square and in no hurry to leave.
tal_vet_sandbagged.icon: stacked burlap sandbags with insect claw gouges, chitin shard embedded, dusty light

tal_vet_hold_fast.description: Plant the boots, square the shoulders and let the whole hive come to you. They usually do, and they usually regret it.
tal_vet_hold_fast.icon: steel shield braced against a giant mandible, sparks spraying, boots dug into pavement

tal_vet_bayonet_drill.description: Long point, short point, withdraw. The straw dummies at Camp Kearny never fought back, but the lesson took all the same.
tal_vet_bayonet_drill.icon: bayonet lunging through a straw training dummy, straw bursting, motion streaks

tal_vet_marching_order.description: Sixty pounds of pack up a Vosges hill builds a man's back. Hollywood's hills are kinder, and the load is mostly ammunition now.
tal_vet_marching_order.icon: heavy canvas army pack with rolled blanket and entrenching tool, sunlit road

tal_vet_no_mans_land.description: Nobody who crossed the wire comes home wasting a swing. You find the soft joint in the chitin the way you found the gap in the barbed wire.
tal_vet_no_mans_land.icon: tangled barbed wire silhouetted against flare-lit smoky sky, red glow

tal_vet_whistle.description: A tin whistle, a lungful of air, and every man goes up the ladder at once. Some habits a fellow never puts in the attic.
tal_vet_whistle.icon: brass trench whistle on a lanyard mid-blast, shrill gleam, smoke behind

tal_vet_bar_room.description: Learned in the back rooms of Gower Street speakeasies: hit first, hit low, and never let the other fellow finish his sentence.
tal_vet_bar_room.icon: fist wrapped in tape smashing through a whiskey glass, liquor splashing

tal_vet_thick_skull.description: The doctors at Letterman said the shrapnel should have killed you. Your mother said you were always too stubborn to listen.
tal_vet_thick_skull.icon: dented doughboy helmet with a shrapnel crease, cracked chinstrap, faint glow

tal_vet_rifle_butt.description: When the magazine's empty and the bug's too close, the wrong end of a Springfield works just as well. Better, some say.
tal_vet_rifle_butt.icon: rifle stock swinging into an insect head, chitin fragments flying, motion arc

tal_vet_footwork.description: The Legion stadium on El Centro teaches you to slip a punch on sawdust. A pincer comes slower than a middleweight's left.
tal_vet_footwork.icon: boxer's boots pivoting on sawdust-strewn canvas, sawdust spraying, ring rope behind

tal_stn_roadwork.description: Five miles before breakfast, up Vine and back, in a sweatshirt and borrowed boots. The fellows at the Legion stadium swear by it, and so do their lungs.
tal_stn_roadwork.icon: worn boxing boots pounding a dawn sidewalk, breath steaming in cold air

tal_stn_haymaker.description: Every extra in Gower Gulch can see it coming from across the lot. The trick is that seeing it coming doesn't help one bit.
tal_stn_haymaker.icon: a huge bare fist swinging in a wide arc, motion blur trailing behind

tal_stn_glass_jaw.description: Ten years of taking stage punches that landed for real. The jaw is set like poured concrete now, and the dentist sends a card at Christmas.
tal_stn_glass_jaw.icon: a square stubbled jaw absorbing a punch, sparks scattering off the chin

tal_stn_dirty_pool.description: The Marquess of Queensberry never fought a four-metre beetle. A knee where it counts, a thumb in the eye, and back for more.
tal_stn_dirty_pool.icon: a knee driving upward into a chitinous insect underbelly, green spatter

tal_stn_sharp_edges.description: A whetstone in the hip pocket and a habit of using it between takes. The blade finds the seams in the shell like it knows the way.
tal_stn_sharp_edges.icon: a gleaming knife edge drawn across a whetstone, bright sparks flying

tal_stn_quick_hands.description: Card tricks at the commissary, coin rolls on set, a knife where nobody saw one a moment ago. The hands move before the eyes catch up.
tal_stn_quick_hands.icon: blurred hands flipping a knife between fingers, ghostly afterimages

tal_stn_flurry.description: The second unit shoots the fights the stars won't do, fast and cheap and all in one go. Nobody counts the cuts, least of all the bug.
tal_stn_flurry.icon: several knife slashes crisscrossing in silver arcs against a dark background

tal_stn_props_dept.description: Prop bottles are sugar glass. These are not. The props man looks the other way, and Prohibition makes sure the bottles are already empty.
tal_stn_props_dept.icon: a heavy glass bottle shattering against an insect head, shards glittering

tal_stn_tuck_and_roll.description: Hit the ground shoulder first, chin tucked, and come up running. Every stuntman learns it on the mat, or learns it in the hospital.
tal_stn_tuck_and_roll.icon: a figure curled mid-roll across dusty ground, motion lines circling

tal_stn_cable_work.description: Months on piano wire and pulleys teach a body to move light and quick. The rigging is gone, but the feet still remember it.
tal_stn_cable_work.icon: taut steel cables and a pulley glowing against a dark studio rafter

tal_stn_high_fall.description: Off the top of a set, through the awning, onto whatever waits below. The cardboard boxes are optional; landing on something with legs is better.
tal_stn_high_fall.icon: a stuntman plunging from a rooftop ledge, coat flaring, city lights below

tal_stn_one_take.description: Film stock costs money, and so does a second try. Get it right the first time, then get up and do it again.
tal_stn_one_take.icon: a wooden clapperboard snapping shut with a burst of white light

tal_gun_steady_hand.description: Breath out slow, squeeze, don't pull. The rifle sits still as a tripod while the bug crosses the sights.
tal_gun_steady_hand.icon: a gloved hand steadying a rifle forend on a sandbag, crosshair glow ahead

tal_gun_long_sight.description: Years of watching ridgelines teach the eye to catch a feeler twitching three blocks off, past the billboards.
tal_gun_long_sight.icon: a narrowed human eye reflecting a distant insect silhouette on a hilltop

tal_gun_dead_eye.description: Some men hit the bug. You hit the soft joint between the plates, every time, like threading a needle.
tal_gun_dead_eye.icon: a bullet striking the glowing seam between two chitin plates, green spray

tal_gun_dead_to_rights.description: The bug has nowhere left to go, and it knows. You finish the sentence the way a judge would.
tal_gun_dead_to_rights.icon: rifle muzzle pressed close to a cornered insect head, muzzle flash blooming

tal_gun_fast_draw.description: Learned from the Gower Gulch cowboys, who practised it between takes for a dollar a day and lunch. The iron clears leather before the mandibles open.
tal_gun_fast_draw.icon: a revolver blurring out of a leather holster, motion streaks and spark

tal_gun_show_off.description: A little flourish never hurt anybody, except the bug. The extras on the sidewalk still clap.
tal_gun_show_off.icon: a revolver spinning on a fingertip, brass casings tumbling in golden light

tal_gun_fanning.description: Palm slapping the hammer, six shots in a heartbeat. Tom Mix did it for the camera; you do it for keeps.
tal_gun_fanning.icon: a palm fanning a revolver hammer, a fan of six orange muzzle flashes

tal_gun_cool_head.description: The bug screams, the street burns, and you are thinking about where you left your hat. Nerves like that pay for themselves.
tal_gun_cool_head.icon: a calm gunman lighting a cigarette amid swirling green smoke and sparks

tal_gun_tracker.description: Broken chaparral, a smear of ichor on a fence post. You follow the trail at a hunter's lope through Griffith Park brush.
tal_gun_tracker.icon: boots striding past three-toed insect tracks in dusty earth, trail glowing faintly

tal_gun_camp_life.description: Cold beans, a bedroll under a pepper tree and the dog for a pillow. Nights in Vermont Canyon toughen a body up.
tal_gun_camp_life.icon: a campfire with a tin coffee pot and bedroll, dog curled beside it

tal_gun_hamstring.description: Aim low for the leg joint. A bug that can't run is a bug that waits politely for the second shot.
tal_gun_hamstring.icon: a bullet shattering a jointed insect leg at the knee, chitin shards flying

tal_gun_buckshot.description: Hand-loaded shells packed heavier than Stembridge would ever rent out. The kick bruises a shoulder and empties a doorway.
tal_gun_buckshot.icon: a shotgun blast of heavy pellets tearing through a swarm, red shell ejecting

tal_pre_laying_on.description: The preacher's palms press flat on a fevered brow and stay there, firm as a notary's stamp, until the shaking stops.
tal_pre_laying_on.icon: two weathered hands pressed on a bandaged forehead, warm golden light seeping between fingers

tal_pre_tent_revival.description: Sawdust floor, canvas walls, a hundred folding chairs and one voice that will not quit before midnight. The spirit catches like dry brush.
tal_pre_tent_revival.icon: a canvas revival tent glowing from within at night, lantern light spilling through the flap

tal_pre_hymnal.description: The old hymns come easier now, every verse by heart, and the wounded find themselves humming along between gasps.
tal_pre_hymnal.icon: a worn hymnal open mid-song, pages lifting in a glowing breeze of light

tal_pre_collection.description: Pass the plate and folks give what they can: a nickel, a button, a moment's rest. It all adds up by Sunday.
tal_pre_collection.icon: a brass collection plate heaped with nickels and buttons, soft halo rising

tal_pre_teetotal.description: Not a drop since Coolidge. The liver is pristine, the knees are sturdy, and the bootleggers on Vine cross the street to avoid the sermon.
tal_pre_teetotal.icon: a smashed whiskey bottle beneath a black preacher's boot, glass shards glittering

tal_pre_blessing.description: The blessing settles on a shoulder like a good wool coat and stays put, long after the amen.
tal_pre_blessing.icon: a pale golden mantle of light draped over a soldier's shoulders, shimmering edges

tal_pre_dry_county.description: No liquor, no excuses, no soft spots. A body kept dry and plain takes a blow the way a church door takes a storm.
tal_pre_dry_county.icon: a whitewashed church door standing firm against wind-driven dust and insect claws

tal_pre_pledge.description: Sign the temperance pledge and the Lord keeps His end promptly. The blessing comes round again before the ink is dry.
tal_pre_pledge.icon: a fountain pen signing a ribboned pledge card, gold sparks rising from the nib

tal_pre_brimstone.description: The sermon smells of sulphur now. Insects in the front pews start to smoke at the joints before the second point.
tal_pre_brimstone.icon: a yellow sulphur flame bursting from an open pulpit Bible, embers flying

tal_pre_rebuke.description: A word from the pulpit, sharp as a ruler across the knuckles. Even a hive drone flinches at being told off properly.
tal_pre_rebuke.icon: a pointing finger crackling with white fire, a giant mantis recoiling in its glare

tal_pre_wrath.description: Some days the Lord is patient. Other days He lends the preacher a cane and a very good aim.
tal_pre_wrath.icon: a walking cane striking down, blazing with righteous orange fire and green ichor spray

tal_pre_fear.description: Damnation described in such loving detail that beetles the size of Packards turn tail and scuttle for the hills.
tal_pre_fear.icon: a fierce preacher's silhouette against roaring hellfire, insect shadows fleeing outward

tal_mec_tinkerer.description: Every alarm clock on the Boulevard has been opened up on a kitchen table at least once. You just never stopped asking how things work.
tal_mec_tinkerer.icon: a pocket watch splayed open on a workbench, tiny gears glowing amber under a magnifier

tal_mec_caltrops.description: A keg of roofing nails from a Gower Street lumberyard, scattered wide. Six legs feel every one of them.
tal_mec_caltrops.icon: bent roofing nails scattered across asphalt, an insect claw recoiling, green ichor droplets

tal_mec_welder.description: Open the acetylene valve another quarter turn. The flame goes from orange to a hissing blue that cuts chitin like tin.
tal_mec_welder.icon: a welding torch flame burning fierce blue, sparks showering off a cracked insect shell

tal_mec_spare_parts.description: Coat pockets full of washers, cotter pins and a carburettor float nobody asked about. Something always fits.
tal_mec_spare_parts.icon: a tin coffee can spilling bolts, springs and washers, faint golden glow inside

tal_mec_torque.description: It's not the size of the wrench, it's the shoulders behind it. Put your back into the swing and the bolt gives.
tal_mec_torque.icon: a huge pipe wrench mid-swing, curved motion arc, sparks at the jaw

tal_mec_shop_floor.description: Ten years hauling engine blocks across a Burbank garage floor builds the kind of arms that don't need a hoist.
tal_mec_shop_floor.icon: grease-stained forearms lifting an engine block on chains, steam rising, warm shop light

tal_mec_heavy_iron.description: Forged steel, no aluminium nonsense. When it lands, the bug knows it was hit by something made in Pittsburgh.
tal_mec_heavy_iron.icon: a dark forged sledgehammer head glowing red-hot at the edges on an anvil

tal_mec_pile_driver.description: Borrowed from a pier crew in San Pedro, near enough. Each blow lands like a piling going into bedrock, and comes back around sooner.
tal_mec_pile_driver.icon: a steam-driven hammer slamming down, white steam jets, cracked ground beneath

tal_mec_coveralls.description: Heavy denim, double-stitched, stiff with a decade of motor oil. Mandibles slide right off the grime.
tal_mec_coveralls.icon: oil-stained blue denim coveralls hanging on a hook, an insect claw snapped against the fabric

tal_mec_patch.description: Why use a strip of rubber when you can use the whole inner tube? A wider patch holds a fellow together longer.
tal_mec_patch.icon: a large rubber patch pressed over a torn arm, glowing green-white healing seam

tal_mec_overhaul.description: Strip it down, clean it, put it back together better than the factory did. Works on Fords and on people, mostly.
tal_mec_overhaul.icon: a toolbox thrown open with tools floating in a ring of healing golden light

tal_mec_grease.description: They called you a grease monkey at the Packard dealership. Now the grease is the only reason you're still standing.
tal_mec_grease.icon: a grease-blackened hand gripping a spanner, thick oil dripping, sturdy warm glow

tal_pow_magnesium.description: A pinch more magnesium in the flash tray. The bugs see white for a long second, and so does anyone who forgot to look away.
tal_pow_magnesium.icon: a flash tray erupting in blinding white magnesium light, sparks scattering outward

tal_pow_long_fuse.description: Cut the fuse long and let it hiss. A patient man gets more out of every inch of powder.
tal_pow_long_fuse.icon: a long coiled fuse burning slowly across a wooden floor, orange sparks trailing

tal_pow_burn.description: Some fires flare and die. Yours settle in like a boarder who pays on time and never leaves.
tal_pow_burn.icon: glowing embers smouldering deep inside a charred insect carapace, thin smoke curling

tal_pow_squib.description: The same little charges that burst blood packs on Western sets, wired tighter and packed meaner. Nobody yells cut.
tal_pow_squib.icon: a tiny squib charge bursting open on a wire, green ichor spraying outward

tal_pow_lampblack.description: A smear of soot across the face and coat. In a smoky room, a man the colour of smoke is hard to hit.
tal_pow_lampblack.icon: a soot-blackened hand smearing lampblack, figure fading into dark grey haze

tal_pow_fog_machine.description: The studio fog rig, mended with baling wire and a prayer. It coughs up a fresh bank sooner than it ought to.
tal_pow_fog_machine.icon: a battered brass fog machine belching thick white clouds across a soundstage floor

tal_pow_cover.description: Stay low, stay in the haze, and let the claws find the drifting smoke instead of you.
tal_pow_cover.icon: a crouched figure in thick smoke as an insect claw slashes through empty haze

tal_pow_smokescreen.description: Navy men taught it on destroyers in the war. A screen that thick hides a retreat or a whole ambush.
tal_pow_smokescreen.icon: a towering wall of dense grey smoke rolling down a moonlit street

tal_pow_black_powder.description: Good old-fashioned black powder, the kind grandfather used on tree stumps. Coarse, honest and loud.
tal_pow_black_powder.icon: a spilled powder horn pouring black grains, a single spark landing among them

tal_pow_steady.description: Hands that never shook through Mack Sennett's worst stunts. A steady hand makes a clever head.
tal_pow_steady.icon: two steady hands crimping a blasting cap, lamplight glinting off the copper

tal_pow_keg.description: The prop department said the keg was too big. The prop department is not out here fighting bugs.
tal_pow_keg.icon: an oversized powder keg with lit fuse rolling toward a hive wall

tal_pow_charge.description: Pack it in a cone, point it right, and the whole blast goes where you send it. Mining men swear by it.
tal_pow_charge.icon: a cone-shaped charge blasting a concentrated jet of fire through insect chitin

tal_elc_high_tension.description: Run the line hot enough and the arc jumps before you ask it to. The wire hums like a hornet shut in a mason jar.
tal_elc_high_tension.icon: porcelain high-tension insulators on a pylon crackling with blue arcs against a night sky

tal_elc_bare_copper.description: Strip the insulation and the current bites harder. The union safety man would have words, but he's in a cocoon on Stage 4.
tal_elc_bare_copper.icon: stripped copper wire ends glinting, a fat white spark leaping between them

tal_elc_live_wire.description: A live cable whipped across a soundstage floor finds whatever is standing on it. Bugs, as a rule, stand on a great many legs.
tal_elc_live_wire.icon: a severed live cable writhing across wet floorboards, spitting yellow sparks

tal_elc_forked.description: Lightning never cared for one road. Yours leaps from shell to shell down the line, quick as gossip at the Brown Derby.
tal_elc_forked.icon: a lightning bolt splitting into three forks, striking three green insect carapaces

tal_elc_carbon_arc.description: The carbon rods burn white as a July noon. Sun arcs lit the dogfights in Hell's Angels; now they light anything with antennae.
tal_elc_carbon_arc.icon: carbon arc rods blazing white-hot inside an open studio lamp housing

tal_elc_key_light.description: The cameraman's first rule: set your key light and everything else falls into place. Think the shot through before you throw the switch.
tal_elc_key_light.icon: a single brass studio spotlight on a stand throwing one hard golden beam

tal_elc_spill.description: Light never stays where the gaffer puts it. Neither does the harm, and nobody on the receiving end files a complaint.
tal_elc_spill.icon: bright light spilling past a lamp's barn doors into drifting haze

tal_elc_blackout.description: Pull the main breaker and a whole stage goes dark. Practice makes the trip quicker, and the bugs never get used to it.
tal_elc_blackout.icon: a gloved hand yanking down a knife-switch breaker, sparks flying into darkness

tal_elc_dynamo.description: A man who works beside a running dynamo learns to take a jolt and keep his feet. The hum gets into his bones.
tal_elc_dynamo.icon: a cast-iron dynamo with spinning armature, blue glow sparking at the brushes

tal_elc_grounded.description: Every good rig has its ground wire. Run one through your own coat and the worst of it drains harmlessly into the floor.
tal_elc_grounded.icon: a copper grounding rod driven into earth, blue current flowing down into dirt

tal_elc_flywheel.description: Once a flywheel spins up, it keeps turning long after the motor quits. A good electrician finds his second wind the same way.
tal_elc_flywheel.icon: a massive iron flywheel spinning with motion blur, oil gleaming on its rim

tal_elc_overload.description: Anyone can blow a fuse. It takes a studio electrician to blow one on purpose, on the cheap, and exactly where the bug is standing.
tal_elc_overload.icon: an open fuse box with a glass fuse bursting in a white flash

tal_nur_quick_dressing.description: Gauze goes on in three turns and a knot, before the man has finished swearing. The Army taught it; the Boulevard perfected it.
tal_nur_quick_dressing.icon: a nurse's hands whipping a white gauze bandage around a bleeding forearm, motion blur

tal_nur_night_shift.description: The lamps on Hollywood Boulevard go dark at ten. The aid station does not, and neither does she, beside a pot of coffee long gone cold.
tal_nur_night_shift.icon: a starched nurse's cap beside a dim oil lamp and a cold coffee cup at night

tal_nur_triage.description: Three men on the pavement and one pair of hands. She looks once at each and knows who can wait.
tal_nur_triage.icon: a red cross chalked on pavement between three stretchers under harsh lamplight

tal_nur_salts.description: One whiff of ammonia and a fainted extra sits bolt upright, ready to fight a beetle the size of a Ford.
tal_nur_salts.icon: a cracked smelling-salts vial releasing a sharp burst of pale stinging vapour

tal_nur_tonic.description: Nobody reads the label too closely, which is a mercy under the Volstead Act. It warms the blood all the same.
tal_nur_tonic.icon: an amber patent-medicine bottle glowing warmly, a drop trickling down the glass

tal_nur_bedside.description: A calm voice, a cool hand, and a promise that the doctor is on his way. Nobody has seen the doctor since August.
tal_nur_bedside.icon: a nurse's hand resting on a patient's brow, bathed in soft golden light

tal_nur_surgery.description: Under a flickering lamp, with the hive humming through the walls, the blade does not waver by a hair.
tal_nur_surgery.icon: a gleaming scalpel held steady over white linen, one bright glint on its edge

tal_nur_rationing.description: Half a roll of gauze, a quarter-bottle of carbolic, a pencil tally on the cupboard door. Nothing under the Dome is wasted twice.
tal_nur_rationing.icon: a half-empty supply cupboard, pencil tally marks on the door, neatly stacked bandage rolls

tal_nur_iodine.description: It stings a man and blisters a bug. The brown stains on her cuffs tell you which she's been treating lately.
tal_nur_iodine.icon: a glass dropper dripping brown iodine onto green insect carapace, hissing smoke rising

tal_nur_ether.description: A soaked pad, a sweet heavy smell, and something with far too many legs forgets what it was doing.
tal_nur_ether.icon: a cotton pad soaked in ether, pale shimmering fumes curling around a twitching insect antenna

tal_nur_lab_coat.description: Starched cotton, stained with things that ought not to exist. It turns acid and spit better than you would think.
tal_nur_lab_coat.icon: a starched white lab coat, acid droplets beading and sliding off its sleeve with a faint sheen

tal_nur_sedative.description: The label says one spoonful. The label was written for people, not for a hornet as long as a delivery truck.
tal_nur_sedative.icon: a glass hypodermic syringe, plunger driven home, violet sedative glowing in the barrel

tal_vet_iron_nerve.description: Shells came down at Belleau Wood and he kept digging. A bug the size of a Ford is just one more thing that won't hurry him.
tal_vet_iron_nerve.icon: steady hand holding a lit cigarette as dirt and shell bursts rain down, unshaking

tal_vet_hard_tack.description: Army biscuit hard enough to drive nails. Men who lived on it in France find a hive siege no great hardship on the stomach.
tal_vet_hard_tack.icon: cracked square army biscuit on a dented mess tin, bent fork beside it, warm lamplight

tal_vet_over_and_out.description: Over the top and out the other side. The whistle blows, the line goes forward, and whatever waits in the wire gets the bayonet.
tal_vet_over_and_out.icon: brass trench whistle glowing gold on a chain, soldiers surging over sandbags behind

tal_vet_shell_shocked_calm.description: Some men came home shaking. Some came home very, very still. The stillness keeps a fellow on his feet long after sense says lie down.
tal_vet_shell_shocked_calm.icon: soldier's blank stare under a dented helmet, red flare light, smoke drifting past

tal_vet_cauliflower_ear.description: Years of Legion smokers at El Centro and Selma taught him to roll with a punch, whether it comes from a heavyweight or a mandible.
tal_vet_cauliflower_ear.icon: lumpy swollen boxer's ear under a harsh ring light, sweat beads glistening

tal_vet_saloon_shove.description: No need to wind up for it. A short jab with the rifle butt, same as clearing the bar rail on payday.
tal_vet_saloon_shove.icon: rifle butt slamming into an insect thorax, splintered bar rail flying, impact flash

tal_vet_prohibition_gin.description: A medicinal pint from a friendly druggist. It tastes like turpentine and puts colour back in a man's face faster than it has any right to.
tal_vet_prohibition_gin.icon: unlabelled bottle of cloudy gin beside a chipped enamel bathtub, soft amber glow

tal_vet_knuckle_duster.description: Brass knuckles on the off hand put weight behind every thrust. The Marquis of Queensberry never wrote rules for anything with six legs.
tal_vet_knuckle_duster.icon: brass knuckles gleaming on a fist driving a bayonet forward, sparks flying

tal_vet_the_clinch.description: Tie up the arms, lean in, smother the punches. It works on a southpaw from San Pedro and, it turns out, on a mantis.
tal_vet_the_clinch.icon: brawler locking a giant mantis's forelimbs in a bear hug, both straining, dim ring lights

tal_vet_rough_house.description: He kicks over tables, insults their mothers and makes himself the loudest thing in the room. The bugs take it personally.
tal_vet_rough_house.icon: overturned saloon table mid-air, chairs flying, a brawler roaring with fists raised

tal_vet_stunt_double.description: Padding borrowed from the stunt department, sewn under the tunic. Built to take a fall from a stagecoach, it takes a claw nearly as well.
tal_vet_stunt_double.icon: quilted stunt padding laced under a torn army tunic, claw marks glancing off

tal_vet_back_lot_scrapper.description: Learned between the false fronts on the backlot, where extras settled their quarrels. Fight short, fight dirty, and find the soft spot first.
tal_vet_back_lot_scrapper.icon: fist cracking into a jaw between plywood western false fronts, dust flying

tal_vet_speakeasy_bouncer.description: Clearing a crowded speakeasy at closing time takes one broad swing and no apologies. The hive gets the same courtesy.
tal_vet_speakeasy_bouncer.icon: broad arcing club swing sweeping three insects off their legs, curved motion streak

tal_vet_studio_muscle.description: The studios paid good money for big men to stand at the gate and look discouraging. He has the build and has kept it.
tal_vet_studio_muscle.icon: broad-shouldered guard in shirtsleeves before a studio gate, arms folded, floodlight behind

tal_vet_last_man_standing.description: When the line breaks and the others go down, something old and stubborn wakes in him. Nothing lands clean after that.
tal_vet_last_man_standing.icon: lone soldier atop a rubble heap, insect claws deflecting off his raised forearm, sunset glare

tal_vet_pugs_grin.description: Missing teeth, a flattened nose and a smile that says he has tasted worse than whatever the hive is spitting.
tal_vet_pugs_grin.icon: gap-toothed boxer grinning through green venom spatter, broken nose, bright ring light

tal_stn_studio_gym.description: Mornings on the pulley weights in the lot gym, between calls. The muscle a picture needs, built where the extras eat their lunch.
tal_stn_studio_gym.icon: a leather medicine ball and iron dumbbell on a studio gym floor, chalk dust rising

tal_stn_cauliflower_ear.description: Every fall and fistfight leaves something behind. Yours is an ear like a boiled cabbage and a body that has stopped taking hits personally.
tal_stn_cauliflower_ear.icon: a battered brown leather boxing headguard hanging on a ring post, warm spotlight

tal_stn_pulled_punch.description: Studio fighters learn a punch that misses by an inch on camera. Out here you throw the same tidy swing, minus the wasted wind-up.
tal_stn_pulled_punch.icon: a bare fist stopping just short of a jaw, faint curved motion arc

tal_stn_main_event.description: You fight like the last reel, when the whole house is on its feet and the organist leans on every key at once.
tal_stn_main_event.icon: a spotlit boxing ring under a stadium roof, gloved fist raised in white glare

tal_stn_two_reel_brawler.description: Two reels, twenty minutes, a saloon fight in each. You learned to keep swinging long after the comedian would have taken his pie and gone home.
tal_stn_two_reel_brawler.icon: two film reels crossed behind a pair of taped knuckles, flickering projector light

tal_stn_bums_rush.description: Grab a collar, grab a belt, and run them out the door. The bouncers at the Brown Derby never did it quicker.
tal_stn_bums_rush.icon: a chitinous insect hurled through swinging saloon doors, splinters and motion streaks

tal_stn_stand_up_guy.description: You don't back down and you don't go down. Forearms come up, the blow slides off, and you're still standing there waiting.
tal_stn_stand_up_guy.icon: a raised forearm deflecting a hooked insect claw, sparks of impact

tal_stn_below_the_belt.description: The Marquess of Queensberry never fought anything with six legs. A knee where it counts costs you nothing but your good name.
tal_stn_below_the_belt.icon: a boot kicking low into an insect's jointed legs, green ichor spattering

tal_stn_sucker_punch.description: Wait until they look at somebody else. The best punch in any picture is the one the heavy never saw coming.
tal_stn_sucker_punch.icon: a fist swinging out of shadow toward an unaware insect head, knuckles glinting

tal_stn_iron_chin.description: The studio doctor gave up X-raying your jaw years ago. Whatever comes at you, the leather holds and the chin behind it holds too.
tal_stn_iron_chin.icon: a square jaw taking a heavy punch, shockwave ripples and bursting stars

tal_stn_top_billing.description: Your name above the title, in the biggest bulbs on the marquee. In a fight like this, everyone else is a supporting player.
tal_stn_top_billing.icon: a blazing theatre marquee of electric bulbs above a boxer's dark silhouette

tal_stn_second_wind.description: A gulp of air, a slap on the cheek, and the legs come back. Every stuntman knows the sweet moment just after the bell.
tal_stn_second_wind.icon: a cold sponge squeezed over a fighter's bowed head, droplets shining

tal_stn_whetstone_habit.description: Between takes you sit on an apple box and stroke the blade across a stone. The prop men call it nerves. The blade calls it good.
tal_stn_whetstone_habit.icon: a knife blade drawn across a grey whetstone, bright sparks flying

tal_stn_switchblade_draw.description: Thumb on the button, blade out before the hand stops moving. Not one wasted motion between the pocket and the work.
tal_stn_switchblade_draw.icon: a switchblade snapping open in a gloved hand, flash of steel

tal_stn_cutting_room_floor.description: The editors at Paramount cut whole scenes in a breath. You've learned to cut just as fast, and leave as much on the floor.
tal_stn_cutting_room_floor.icon: curled film scraps and green ichor on a floor, a knife lying among them

tal_stn_sugar_glass.description: Prop bottles are boiled sugar and break pretty. Real ones break meaner, and there is always another one behind the bar.
tal_stn_sugar_glass.icon: a glass bottle shattering against insect chitin, shards glittering in lamplight

tal_stn_union_break.description: Ten minutes every two hours, the contract says. You've learned to catch your breath in half that and still call it a break.
tal_stn_union_break.icon: a tin coffee cup steaming on an apple box beside a resting knife

tal_stn_fairbanks_footwork.description: Douglas Fairbanks made swordplay look like dancing on his Santa Monica Boulevard lot. You picked up the footwork, and the knack for turning blades aside.
tal_stn_fairbanks_footwork.icon: a dagger turning aside an insect mandible in a swashbuckler's lunge

tal_stn_deep_pockets.description: A stuntman's coat has a pocket for everything: tape, smelling salts, a spare knife, a chocolate bar. You never run dry in a long fight.
tal_stn_deep_pockets.icon: an open coat lining stuffed with knives, tape and a chocolate bar

tal_stn_thousand_cuts.description: No single cut finishes it. The hundredth does, or the thousandth, and you have nowhere else to be tonight.
tal_stn_thousand_cuts.icon: a whirl of silver knife slashes encircling a reeling giant insect

tal_vet_mess_hall_rations.description: Bully beef, hardtack and coffee you could stand a spoon in. Nobody liked it, but it kept a man on his feet till Tuesday.
tal_vet_mess_hall_rations.icon: a dented tin of bully beef beside a steaming enamel mug, warm lamplight glow

tal_vet_kitcheners_stare.description: The old recruiting-poster glare, pointing finger and all. A Veteran holds the line now without spending half his breath shouting about it.
tal_vet_kitcheners_stare.icon: a stern mustached face with pointing finger, eyes glinting hard, bold poster shading

tal_vet_duckboard_footing.description: Months on slatted boards over Flanders mud taught him where his feet go. A shield set on firm footing does not give.
tal_vet_duckboard_footing.icon: muddy wooden duckboards beneath a raised steel shield, rain streaking down

tal_vet_dugout_discipline.description: He learned to go to ground fast when the whistle blew. Sandbags, shovel, head down, all before the second shell lands.
tal_vet_dugout_discipline.icon: an entrenching shovel biting into sandbags, dirt spraying, shell flash behind

tal_vet_second_wind.description: Halfway up Vine with a bug the size of a Packard behind him, something old and stubborn kicks in. The breath comes back.
tal_vet_second_wind.icon: a soldier's chest heaving, pale breath steaming in cold night air, golden glow

tal_vet_spit_and_polish.description: Boots blacked, buttons bright, helmet strap mended. A man who keeps his kit in order finds the claws skid off it more often.
tal_vet_spit_and_polish.icon: a gleaming polished steel helmet, an insect claw glancing off in bright sparks

tal_vet_drill_sergeant.description: A voice that once cleared a parade ground at Camp Kearny. The bugs turn toward it the way the recruits used to.
tal_vet_drill_sergeant.icon: a shouting sergeant's open mouth, sound rings rippling outward, swagger stick raised

tal_vet_dry_socks.description: Every veteran remembers trench foot. Fresh wool socks mean quick feet, and quick feet mean the stinger hits pavement instead.
tal_vet_dry_socks.icon: grey wool socks drying on a bayonet beside a glowing brazier, steam rising

tal_vet_rum_ration.description: Prohibition says no. The Sergeant says a tot before the push never hurt anybody, and he keeps a flask to prove it.
tal_vet_rum_ration.icon: a stone rum jar tipping amber liquid into a tin cup, warm glow

tal_vet_kit_inspection.description: Bayonet oiled, entrenching tool sharpened, nothing rattling. A clean kit swings easier and wastes less of the man carrying it.
tal_vet_kit_inspection.icon: soldier's kit laid neatly on a blanket, bayonet gleaming under lantern light

tal_vet_the_last_ditch.description: There is always one more trench behind you, until there isn't. In that last one, a Veteran stops being a man and becomes a wall.
tal_vet_the_last_ditch.icon: a lone soldier in a sandbagged trench, helmet and shield blazing with defiant light

tal_vet_stripes_earned.description: Not handed out at Central Casting. Sewn on in France, for men who carried more than their share and brought others home.
tal_vet_stripes_earned.icon: sergeant's chevrons on a khaki sleeve glowing gold, clenched fist below

tal_vet_fixed_bayonets.description: The click of a bayonet locking home on the lug. After that, every lunge comes cheap and comes without a second thought.
tal_vet_fixed_bayonets.icon: a bayonet snapping onto a rifle muzzle, bright spark at the catch

tal_vet_creeping_barrage.description: Walk the fire forward and walk in behind it. His swings roll across a swarm like shellbursts across no man's land.
tal_vet_creeping_barrage.icon: a line of orange shellbursts advancing across a swarm of insects, drifting smoke

tal_vet_lee_enfield_weight.description: Nine pounds of rifle changes a man's idea of a blow. He swings everything now as if it had a brass butt plate.
tal_vet_lee_enfield_weight.icon: a rifle butt smashing down on an insect carapace, cracks and green ichor spraying

tal_vet_trench_raider.description: Night raids taught quick work in close quarters: in, swing, out before the flares go up. The habit never left him.
tal_vet_trench_raider.icon: a spiked trench club swinging in moonlight, flare glow above, motion blur

tal_vet_short_rush.description: Up, run, down, five seconds and never more, the sergeants said. A Veteran still crosses Highland Avenue that way.
tal_vet_short_rush.icon: army boots mid-stride kicking up dust, motion streaks, crouched running silhouette

tal_vet_blood_up.description: The fight gets into him like a fever. The harder the bugs push, the hotter and steadier he burns.
tal_vet_blood_up.icon: a clenched fist trembling with red heat glow, veins standing out

tal_vet_light_pack.description: Leave the greatcoat, the spare boots and the letters home. Going over the top costs less when you're not hauling a mule's load.
tal_vet_light_pack.icon: a discarded heavy pack at the foot of a trench ladder, soldier climbing upward

tal_vet_kill_or_be_killed.description: The bayonet instructor's only lesson, shouted till it stuck. Twelve years on, the reflexes still answer before the Veteran thinks.
tal_vet_kill_or_be_killed.icon: a soldier twisting aside from a striking mandible, bayonet already counter-thrusting

tal_stn_fade_into_extras.description: In a borrowed coat a stuntman looks like forty other men in borrowed coats. The bugs strike at whoever moved last, and it wasn't him.
tal_stn_fade_into_extras.icon: a knife-wielding figure half-dissolving into a crowd of identical costumed extras, grey haze

tal_stn_stand_in_steel.description: Stand-ins take the star's place under the hot lamps and the falling scenery. The work builds a forearm like a stevedore's.
tal_stn_stand_in_steel.icon: a muscled forearm gripping a steel stiletto under the white glare of a studio lamp

tal_stn_cut_to_ribbons.description: The cutting room never worked this fast. Blades flash left, right and left again until the chitin hangs off in strips.
tal_stn_cut_to_ribbons.icon: two knives slashing through insect chitin, green ribbons of ichor spraying, bright motion arcs

tal_stn_scar_tissue.description: Every stuntman on Gower Street can read his career off his own hide. Old cuts heal tough, and tough is what pays the rent.
tal_stn_scar_tissue.icon: a bare shoulder crossed with old stitched knife scars, lit by a single hanging bulb

tal_stn_padded_costume.description: Wardrobe sews felt and horsehair under the cowboy shirt, where the camera can't see. It looks like nothing and stops plenty.
tal_stn_padded_costume.icon: an open cowboy shirt revealing quilted horsehair padding, stitches glinting in lamplight

tal_stn_sandbag_landing.description: Down below, out of frame, somebody piled the sandbags right. A body that lands soft gets up again, and gets up mad.
tal_stn_sandbag_landing.icon: a stuntman crashing onto a pile of burlap sandbags, dust bursting outward

tal_stn_clock_tower_nerve.description: Lloyd hung off a clock face above Broadway and smiled for the camera. After a few of those, a jump is just a jump.
tal_stn_clock_tower_nerve.icon: a man in a straw boater dangling from the hands of a giant clock above a city street

tal_stn_featherfall.description: Lean men fall cheap. He goes off the ledge like a dropped evening paper, loose and easy, saving his wind for the landing.
tal_stn_featherfall.icon: a figure drifting down from a rooftop ledge, coat flaring like wings, newspaper pages trailing

tal_stn_dive_roll.description: Hit the boards shoulder first, tuck, come up running. Done right, it costs a man no more than a good sneeze.
tal_stn_dive_roll.icon: a stuntman mid-somersault across studio floorboards, a curling dust trail behind him

tal_stn_wire_walker.description: Piano wire strung between two catwalks, a balancing pole, and no net the insurance man would sign for. The feet learn fast.
tal_stn_wire_walker.icon: feet in soft shoes balancing on a taut glinting wire high above a dark soundstage

tal_stn_safety_last.description: Somebody put it on a picture poster as a joke. Stuntmen took it as a working principle and learned to roll with the hit.
tal_stn_safety_last.icon: a battered bowler hat deflecting a giant insect claw, impact stars bursting around it

tal_stn_pratfall_timing.description: A banana peel is comedy; a banana peel at the right moment is art. The same beat puts a knife where the bug isn't guarding.
tal_stn_pratfall_timing.icon: a banana peel on wet cobblestones with a knife blade glinting just beyond it

tal_stn_craft_services.description: Coffee in a tin cup and a ham sandwich off the lunch wagon. Strikes and invasions come and go, but the crew still eats.
tal_stn_craft_services.icon: a steaming tin coffee cup beside a ham sandwich on a wooden crate, warm glow

tal_stn_box_office_draw.description: The crowd at Grauman's still cheers when a man falls off something tall. A stuntman fights better with an audience, even a frightened one.
tal_stn_box_office_draw.icon: a spotlight beam catching a falling stuntman before a cheering silhouetted theatre crowd

tal_stn_the_big_drop.description: The one they put on the poster: off the water tower, straight into the swarm. Nothing with six legs knows where he'll land.
tal_stn_the_big_drop.icon: a man plummeting from a studio water tower onto a giant insect, dust shockwave below

tal_stn_ambulance_standby.description: The studio keeps a Packard ambulance behind the set with the motor running. Knowing it's there makes a man last a little longer.
tal_stn_ambulance_standby.icon: a white 1920s ambulance idling with headlamps glowing, red cross on its side panel

tal_gun_nickelodeon_nerves.description: You grew up in the front row of a nickel picture house, watching train robbers draw. Nothing on the Boulevard rattles a kid raised on that.
tal_gun_nickelodeon_nerves.icon: a nickel coin spinning on a gloved fingertip in a flickering projector beam

tal_gun_encore_shots.description: The crowd at a Wild West show always wanted one more. Fanning the hammer, you give the bugs their encore whether they asked or not.
tal_gun_encore_shots.icon: a palm fanning a revolver hammer, a bright arc of stacked muzzle flashes

tal_gun_ricochet_romance.description: Off a lamppost, off a fire hydrant, into the soft seam behind the carapace. Some shots you'd write home about, if the mail still ran.
tal_gun_ricochet_romance.icon: a glowing bullet trail bouncing off a brass lamppost into a beetle's joint

tal_gun_extra_cylinders.description: A spare cylinder, already loaded, rides in the vest pocket. Swapping it takes a breath instead of a minute, and the mind stays on the work.
tal_gun_extra_cylinders.icon: a loaded revolver cylinder gleaming in an open hand, cartridges catching lamplight

tal_gun_bug_spray.description: A Flit gun's worth of kerosene on the collar and cuffs. The small ones lose interest, and the big ones bite a little less sure.
tal_gun_bug_spray.icon: a hand-pump insect sprayer misting a coat collar, green droplets hanging in air

tal_gun_game_warden.description: You walked the hills for the Fish and Game Commission before the Dome came down. Long miles of chaparral made you hard to wear out.
tal_gun_game_warden.icon: a tin game warden's badge pinned to a weathered canvas jacket, sunlit

tal_gun_snare_line.description: Every trapper knows a crippled quarry is a caught one. You go for the legs quicker now, and the bugs offer plenty of legs to choose from.
tal_gun_snare_line.icon: a wire snare pulling tight around a jointed insect leg, dust kicking up

tal_gun_scattergun.description: A double-barrel and a box of double-ought. You've learned to load by feel and fire without wasting a pellet's worth of thought.
tal_gun_scattergun.icon: two red shotgun shells sliding into an open double-barrel breech

tal_gun_thick_hide_coat.description: A steerhide coat off a Gower Gulch extra who won't be needing it. It turns a mandible about as well as it ever turned the rain.
tal_gun_thick_hide_coat.icon: a heavy brown steerhide coat with a fresh gouge torn by a mandible

tal_gun_big_game_nose.description: Out in Griffith Park you learned what a cornered animal smells like. The hive has a smell too, and it tells you where to aim.
tal_gun_big_game_nose.icon: rifle sights settling on a glowing soft joint in a giant beetle's thorax

tal_gun_exterminators_pride.description: Before the Dome you rid bungalows of termites at two dollars a house. The pay is worse now, but the work has never felt better.
tal_gun_exterminators_pride.icon: a brass exterminator's pump crossed with a rifle over a dead beetle

tal_gun_field_rations.description: A tin of corned beef, a canteen and a heel of bread, eaten crouched behind a billboard. A hunter learns to rest fast and rest anywhere.
tal_gun_field_rations.icon: an open tin of corned beef and a dented canteen beside a small campfire

tal_gun_bushwhacker.description: Lying in the sage above the Pass with your sights settled, you let the bug walk into the shot. Polite folks call it an ambush.
tal_gun_bushwhacker.icon: a rifle barrel poking through dusk sagebrush, a single bright muzzle flash

tal_gun_hard_country.description: Scrambling up the Hollywoodland slopes and down the dry washes every day keeps the legs quick and the hands quicker still.
tal_gun_hard_country.icon: a booted foot leaping across a rocky ravine, gravel spraying, sunset sky

tal_gun_swarm_season.description: When the hive spills out in autumn, nobody counts shells. The scattergun bucks and a whole knot of them comes apart at once.
tal_gun_swarm_season.icon: buckshot spray tearing through a cluster of small flying insects, orange muzzle blast

tal_gun_old_trapper.description: Thirty winters in the Sierra taught you to step aside from a charging bear. A charging beetle is slower, and considerably uglier.
tal_gun_old_trapper.icon: a grizzled trapper sidestepping as a huge beetle lunges past, motion blur

tal_elc_gel_filter.description: A sheet of amber gelatin clipped over the lamp softens the glare. Somehow the bugs find you harder to pin down through it.
tal_elc_gel_filter.icon: a sheet of amber gel clipped over a studio lamp, warm light spilling through

tal_elc_box_office.description: A full house means a full till. Every lamp you light seems to pay a little current back at the ticket window.
tal_elc_box_office.icon: a brass ticket-booth grille with glowing coins of light pouring through it

tal_elc_grand_premiere.description: Klieg lights sweep the sky like opening night for Hell's Angels at Grauman's, and every bug on the street is caught in the beam.
tal_elc_grand_premiere.icon: crossed searchlight beams sweeping a night sky over a theatre forecourt, insects silhouetted

tal_elc_nitrate_stock.description: Old nitrate film burns hot, fast and mean, and no projectionist ever forgets it. Your live wire has picked up the same temper.
tal_elc_nitrate_stock.icon: a curling strip of nitrate film catching a blue spark and flaring white

tal_elc_step_up_coil.description: A wound transformer lifts the line voltage, and your spirits climb right along with it. Steady hands, steady current.
tal_elc_step_up_coil.icon: a copper-wound transformer coil humming inside a faint blue halo

tal_elc_rubber_gloves.description: Thick black rubber, cracked at the knuckles, handed down from the man before you. Wrapping a pal in insulation comes cheaper with them on.
tal_elc_rubber_gloves.icon: a pair of black rubber lineman's gloves crackling with harmless white sparks

tal_elc_surge_protector.description: The breaker trips before the spike gets through, so the insulation is back on the line sooner than anybody expected.
tal_elc_surge_protector.icon: a slate breaker panel with a knife switch snapping open in a spray of sparks

tal_elc_power_station.description: You once stood inside an Edison substation at midnight and listened to it think. Some of that hum never left you.
tal_elc_power_station.icon: a brick substation with tall glass insulators glowing against a dusk sky

tal_elc_carbon_brushes.description: Carbon brushes wear down so the dynamo doesn't. A good electrician learns to take the friction and keep turning.
tal_elc_carbon_brushes.icon: two carbon brushes pressed to a spinning copper commutator, sparks trailing behind

tal_elc_heavy_load.description: Run every lamp on the stage off one circuit and the cable goes warm in your hands. Then the bugs find out why.
tal_elc_heavy_load.icon: a thick rubber power cable glowing cherry red along its length, smoke curling

tal_elc_field_telephone.description: An olive-drab field telephone from the Argonne, rewired to ring the aid station. Help comes quicker when somebody bothered to string the line.
tal_elc_field_telephone.icon: an olive-drab crank field telephone with a soft green glow from its receiver

tal_elc_sandbagged.description: Grips weigh down light stands with sandbags so the wind can't topple them. Turns out the same trick works on electricians.
tal_elc_sandbagged.icon: stacked burlap sandbags around a light stand, an insect claw glancing off them

tal_elc_doughboy_ration.description: Corned willy and hardtack, the same tins the boys ate in France. Nobody likes it. Everybody stays on their feet.
tal_elc_doughboy_ration.icon: an opened tin of corned beef beside hardtack on a dented army mess kit

tal_elc_dugout_shelter.description: Timber, sheet iron and a foot of packed earth. The men who dug in along the Marne taught the crews how to roof a generator pit.
tal_elc_dugout_shelter.icon: a timber and corrugated iron dugout entrance under earth, lantern glowing inside

tal_elc_powerhouse.description: The generator truck roars like a Southern Pacific locomotive, and the current you throw over a friend hums thick enough to stop a mandible cold.
tal_elc_powerhouse.icon: a roaring studio generator truck casting a crackling blue dome of current over a figure

tal_elc_ground_fault.description: Current always finds the shortest road to earth. You just make sure it runs through the bug on the way down.
tal_elc_ground_fault.icon: a jagged white arc leaping from a wrench through an insect leg into wet ground

tal_gun_expert_badge.description: The Army pinned the Expert badge on men who stopped wasting breath on a shot. You still wear yours, inside the coat where it counts.
tal_gun_expert_badge.icon: a silver army marksmanship badge with crossed rifles, gleaming on a dark wool lapel

tal_gun_trench_patience.description: Months in a Flanders trench taught you to wait out anything. A dome of glass is only a longer wait.
tal_gun_trench_patience.icon: a mud-caked doughboy helmet resting on a trench parapet, pale dawn light behind

tal_gun_sandbag_nest.description: A careful gunman never sets up anywhere he can't throw a few sandbags first. Burlap and sand stop more than people think.
tal_gun_sandbag_nest.icon: a ring of stacked burlap sandbags around a rifle barrel, green ichor splattered across them

tal_gun_iron_sights.description: No fancy glass on the barrel, just a notch and a post. Less to fuss with means less to fumble.
tal_gun_iron_sights.icon: view down a rifle's iron sights, front post centred on a glowing insect eye

tal_gun_deep_breath.description: Fill the lungs, let half out, hold. Every rifleman learned it at camp, and it steadies more than the muzzle.
tal_gun_deep_breath.icon: a rifleman's breath fogging in cold blue night air, rifle stock pressed to cheek

tal_gun_pinning_fire.description: Put rounds where the bug wants to go and it soon stops wanting to go anywhere. The legs are the easy part.
tal_gun_pinning_fire.icon: bullets striking chitinous insect legs, dirt kicked up in sprays, the bug buckling

tal_gun_bolt_action_rhythm.description: Lift, back, forward, down. The bolt finds its own tempo, like a fox-trot the band plays only for you.
tal_gun_bolt_action_rhythm.icon: a hand working a rifle bolt, brass casing spinning out in golden motion blur

tal_gun_snap_shooting.description: No time to shoulder it. Fire from wherever the gun already points and trust the years to do the aiming.
tal_gun_snap_shooting.icon: a rifle fired from the hip, muzzle flash bursting sideways, smoke trailing

tal_gun_steady_under_fire.description: You learned in the Argonne that flinching never stopped a bullet. It turns out flinching doesn't stop acid either.
tal_gun_steady_under_fire.icon: a calm gunman kneeling amid hissing green acid splashes, rifle level and unwavering

tal_gun_final_reel.description: Every picture saves its best shot for the last reel. So do you, and nobody walks out before the end.
tal_gun_final_reel.icon: a film reel unspooling into a rifle's smoking muzzle, flickering projector light

tal_gun_one_shot_one_bug.description: One cartridge, one carcass. The quartermaster at Post 43 counts every round of brass and likes your arithmetic.
tal_gun_one_shot_one_bug.icon: a single brass cartridge standing beside a toppled giant beetle, one bullet hole glowing

tal_gun_sergeant_york.description: York took 132 Germans in the Argonne with a rifle and a pistol. The bugs have never heard of him, but they will.
tal_gun_sergeant_york.icon: a battered campaign hat hung on a rifle muzzle, golden light behind it

tal_gun_trick_holster.description: A cutaway holster bought off a Gower Gulch cowboy extra. The gun is out of the leather before the thought is finished.
tal_gun_trick_holster.icon: a tooled leather cutaway holster, revolver leaping out in a blur of motion

tal_gun_matinee_idol.description: You watched Tom Mix do it a hundred Saturday afternoons. Somewhere along the way you started hitting what he only pretends to.
tal_gun_matinee_idol.icon: a white cowboy hat silhouetted in a theatre spotlight, revolver glinting below

tal_gun_six_gun_waltz.description: One-two-three, one-two-three, and the cylinder comes round again. The bugs never did learn to dance.
tal_gun_six_gun_waltz.icon: a revolver cylinder spinning, six chambers ringed in circling muzzle-flash light
