tal_gun_stunt_double.description: A stuntman on the Columbia lot taught you how to fall out of harm's way. Now and then you return the favour.
tal_gun_stunt_double.icon: a gunman diving sideways mid-air, acid spit streaking past his flapping coat

tal_gun_hot_lead.description: Fresh from the barrel and still smoking, it goes through chitin like a nail through a pine box.
tal_gun_hot_lead.icon: a red-hot bullet punching through cracked insect shell, sparks and smoke

tal_gun_rapid_reload.description: Six cartridges held between the fingers like a card sharp's deck. The cylinder is full before the empties hit the pavement.
tal_gun_rapid_reload.icon: fingers pressing brass cartridges into an open revolver cylinder, empties falling

tal_gun_wild_west_show.description: Buffalo Bill's show folded years ago, but its sharpshooters drifted west to the pictures. You picked up their footwork and their swagger.
tal_gun_wild_west_show.icon: a glass ball shattering in midair above a twirling revolver, sawdust arena light

tal_gun_bullet_ballet.description: The dance directors at Fox would pay good money to film it: boots, smoke and gunfire, every step on the beat.
tal_gun_bullet_ballet.icon: a gunman spinning on one heel, twin revolvers firing in an arc of flashes

tal_elc_spark_gap.description: Set the electrodes a hair closer and the spark jumps on less juice. Every juicer on the Paramount lot learns it, or learns it the hard way.
tal_elc_spark_gap.icon: two brass electrodes with a bright blue spark jumping the narrow gap between them

tal_elc_live_rail.description: The Pacific Electric runs six hundred volts through its overhead wire. A smart electrician taps a little of it for himself and lets the railway pay.
tal_elc_live_rail.icon: a red-car trolley pole sparking violently against an overhead wire at night

tal_elc_crossed_wires.description: Two lines touch where they shouldn't, and the current goes looking for every bug in reach. Nobody calls it a mistake twice.
tal_elc_crossed_wires.icon: two frayed copper cables crossing, a crackling arc leaping outward in branching forks

tal_elc_hollywood_current.description: The studios pull more power than half of Los Angeles. A man who has worked their switchboards learns to throw that weight around.
tal_elc_hollywood_current.icon: a studio switchboard with knife switches thrown, sparks spraying from the copper bus bars

tal_elc_rubber_boots.description: Thick rubber soles, laced high. They won't stop a mandible, but they keep a fellow on his feet when the ground goes live.
tal_elc_rubber_boots.icon: heavy black rubber work boots on wet pavement, blue sparks skittering harmlessly around them

tal_elc_quick_draw.description: Throw the switch before you've finished thinking about it. The bugs don't wait, and neither does a good juicer.
tal_elc_quick_draw.icon: a gloved hand yanking a knife switch down, motion streaks and a burst of light

tal_elc_flash_point.description: Push the lines past their rating and everything nearby goes white for an instant. The smell of scorched chitin hangs around for days.
tal_elc_flash_point.icon: a carbon arc lamp bursting in a blinding white flash, glass shards flying outward

tal_elc_long_fuse.description: Ten years splicing cable teaches patience. The electrician who plans the whole circuit before laying a foot of it lives longest.
tal_elc_long_fuse.icon: a blueprint wiring diagram with one circuit line glowing gold under a drafting lamp

tal_elc_feedback_loop.description: The current runs out, comes round and runs back home. A man who wires himself into the loop gets back some of what he spent.
tal_elc_feedback_loop.icon: a closed coil of copper wire with a pulse of glowing current circling it

tal_elc_sparks_fly.description: When the arc catches just right it throws a fountain of sparks, the kind cameramen once paid good money to film.
tal_elc_sparks_fly.icon: a fountain of orange sparks erupting from a struck carbon arc against black

tal_elc_bolt_from_blue.description: No warning, no thunder. One moment the bug is crossing Vine, the next it's a smoking shell and the streetlights are flickering.
tal_elc_bolt_from_blue.icon: a jagged blue lightning bolt striking from a clear dusk sky onto a giant insect

tal_elc_shell_shock.description: Men who heard the guns at the Marne know the jolt of a near miss. A shock that floors a greenhorn barely rattles them.
tal_elc_shell_shock.icon: a dented doughboy helmet crackling with harmless static, smoke curling behind it

tal_elc_klieg_eyes.description: Red, weeping, half blind from the lamps. Every old studio electrician has klieg eyes, and every one can aim a light without looking.
tal_elc_klieg_eyes.icon: a squinting bloodshot eye reflecting a blazing klieg lamp in its pupil

tal_elc_hot_spot.description: Every lamp has one place where the beam burns brightest. Put a bug's head there and watch it smoke.
tal_elc_hot_spot.icon: a white-hot circle of focused light scorching a beetle's shell, smoke rising

tal_elc_barn_doors.description: Fold the hinged shutters in and the light pinches down to a blade. The short goes where it's sent and nowhere else.
tal_elc_barn_doors.icon: a studio lamp with four black barn-door flaps squeezing a hard narrow beam

tal_elc_footlights.description: The old vaudeville footlights warmed a stage from below. A little of that glow keeps an electrician's spirits up between fights.
tal_elc_footlights.icon: a row of warm amber footlights glowing along a dark stage edge

tal_elc_gaffer_tape.description: A roll of black friction tape on the belt mends a bad splice in seconds. Gaffers swear by it; the bugs swear at it.
tal_elc_gaffer_tape.icon: a roll of black cloth tape binding a sparking cable splice tight

tal_elc_searchlight_sweep.description: Premiere-night searchlights still swing across the Dome, and the current follows the beam from one bug to the next.
tal_elc_searchlight_sweep.icon: a premiere searchlight beam sweeping the night sky, insects caught crackling in it

tal_elc_sun_gun.description: A big arc lamp run hot enough to pass for noon. Location crews used them to fake daylight; now they cook bugs.
tal_elc_sun_gun.icon: a massive studio arc lamp blazing like a small sun, heat shimmer rolling off

tal_elc_lamp_glare.description: Throw the full glare in a bug's face and it can't tell where the light ends and the electrician begins.
tal_elc_lamp_glare.icon: a giant insect recoiling, compound eyes dazzled white by a glaring arc lamp

tal_pow_gas_drill.description: Eight seconds to get the mask on, the Army said. Powder men learned it twice: once in France, once beside the chlorine bottles on the effects stage.
tal_pow_gas_drill.icon: a canvas gas mask with round glass eyepieces, yellow-green fog curling around its straps

tal_pow_cordite_haze.description: Through the drifting smoke of the last charge you can see where the bug's shell is thinnest. The bug cannot see you at all.
tal_pow_cordite_haze.icon: blue-grey cordite smoke parting around a glowing insect eye, a bright cut of light slicing through

tal_pow_fog_of_war.description: In a good smoke screen a man is only a rumour. Claws snap shut on the spot where you were standing a moment ago.
tal_pow_fog_of_war.icon: a man's silhouette dissolving into thick white smoke, an insect claw striking empty air

tal_pow_blackout.description: When the arcs go dark on the sound stage, the powder man is the only one who still knows exactly where every charge is buried.
tal_pow_blackout.icon: a pitch-dark sound stage, one hand holding a lit match above a coiled fuse

tal_pow_blasting_cap.description: A copper tube no bigger than a cigarette, and the whole charge waits on it. Crimp it right and the bang comes clean.
tal_pow_blasting_cap.icon: a copper blasting cap with a sputtering fuse, a bright spark flaring at the crimped end

tal_pow_cheap_kegs.description: Cornero's boys left empty beer kegs all over the Valley. Packed with black powder, they hold a better load than they ever held beer.
tal_pow_cheap_kegs.icon: an oak beer keg spilling black powder, a fuse hissing from its bung hole

tal_pow_sappers_patience.description: The tunnellers at Ypres waited weeks in the clay, listening. Breathe slow, count the seconds, and let the fuse do the hurrying.
tal_pow_sappers_patience.icon: a sapper kneeling in a clay tunnel, ear pressed to a listening stick, lantern glow

tal_pow_wrecking_crew.description: The studios tear down a set every Friday and build another by Monday. The powder man was always the fastest hand on a teardown.
tal_pow_wrecking_crew.icon: a painted plaster castle facade bursting apart, timber and canvas flying outward

tal_pow_hazard_pay.description: Union scale for handling explosives was a dollar more a day. The bugs pay nothing, but the hide you grew on the job still holds.
tal_pow_hazard_pay.icon: a singed, smoking pay envelope with silver dollars spilling beside a stick of dynamite

tal_pow_tamped_charge.description: Pack the hole with clay and tamp it hard. A tamped charge wastes nothing on noise and spends everything on the wall.
tal_pow_tamped_charge.icon: a wooden tamping rod packing clay into a drilled hole over red dynamite sticks

tal_pow_messines_ridge.description: June 1917: nineteen mines under the German line, and they heard it in London. A few of the men who dug them work in pictures now.
tal_pow_messines_ridge.icon: a ridge erupting at dawn in a towering column of earth, fire and smoke

tal_pow_hard_hat.description: A tin hat from the Argonne, painted studio grey, dented by one falling klieg light and one very large mandible.
tal_pow_hard_hat.icon: a dented grey steel Brodie helmet, an insect mandible glancing off it in sparks

tal_pow_thick_skull.description: The effects foreman says you have been blown off your feet eleven times this year. You say nine. Neither of you remembers properly.
tal_pow_thick_skull.icon: a soot-blackened man rising from smoking rubble, shaking his head, embers drifting around him

tal_pow_chain_reaction.description: Line the kegs up and light the first. The rest go off like a row of Keystone Cops tumbling down a staircase.
tal_pow_chain_reaction.icon: a row of kegs exploding one after another in a rippling line of orange fire

tal_pow_the_big_bang.description: Every effects man dreams of the shot that needs no retake. The camera shakes, windows go out on Vine Street, and the hive comes down.
tal_pow_the_big_bang.icon: an enormous fireball rising over a collapsing insect hive, a shockwave rippling outward

tal_pow_powder_monkey.description: The Navy's name for the boys who ran powder to the guns. You still run, crate on your shoulder, ducking under the falling sparks.
tal_pow_powder_monkey.icon: a running figure in mid-stride carrying a powder crate, sparks raining down around him

tal_nur_hospital_corners.description: Sheets folded tight, collar starched, cap pinned square. A nurse kept in that kind of order is a hard thing to knock over, and the bugs keep learning it.
tal_nur_hospital_corners.icon: crisp white hospital bed sheet folded into a razor-sharp corner, soft lamplight glow

tal_nur_penicillin_dream.description: A Scotsman in London found a mould that kills germs, the journals say. Nobody can bottle it yet, but she dresses every wound as if she could.
tal_nur_penicillin_dream.icon: blue-green mould bloom spreading in a glass petri dish, glowing softly

tal_nur_miracle_of_lourdes.description: Pilgrims leave their crutches at the grotto. On the operating table she does not wait for the Virgin, though she would never refuse the help.
tal_nur_miracle_of_lourdes.icon: wooden crutch against a candlelit stone grotto, golden light pouring down from above

tal_nur_brisk_gait.description: Rubber heels on linoleum, never running, never late. A good ward nurse covers a city block between bells and arrives looking unhurried.
tal_nur_brisk_gait.icon: white nurse's shoe mid-stride on a polished ward floor, motion streaks behind

tal_nur_bunsen_burner.description: A steady blue flame under a flask of something nobody should drink. It heats slowly, it heats evenly, and it does not forgive.
tal_nur_bunsen_burner.icon: brass Bunsen burner with a sharp blue flame under a bubbling round flask

tal_nur_volatile_mixture.description: Two clear liquids, one careless pour, and the beaker jumps off the bench. She has learned exactly how careless to be.
tal_nur_volatile_mixture.icon: glass beaker erupting with violent green froth, droplets spraying outward

tal_nur_measured_drops.description: Ether by the drop, counted aloud, the way the old anaesthetists taught it. Nothing wasted, and every drop goes where it was meant to.
tal_nur_measured_drops.icon: glass dropper releasing a single shining drop onto a white gauze mask

tal_nur_mustard_memory.description: She worked the gas wards at Étaples and still remembers the yellow blisters. The sedatives she mixes now carry a little of that remembering.
tal_nur_mustard_memory.icon: sickly yellow fog curling from an open brown medicine bottle, eerie glow

tal_nur_fume_hood.description: Behind the glass sash and the roaring fan, the vapours go up the flue instead of down her throat. She brought the habit out into the street.
tal_nur_fume_hood.icon: glass laboratory fume hood drawing swirling green vapour upward into a metal vent

tal_nur_cheap_reagents.description: Iodine by the gallon from a Glendale druggist who asks no questions. It stains the same brown and stings just as hard.
tal_nur_cheap_reagents.icon: large amber gallon jug of iodine sloshing, brown stain spreading across a counter

tal_nur_mad_scientist.description: She reads the German journals by lamplight and fills the margins with notes of her own. The orderlies have started knocking before they come in.
tal_nur_mad_scientist.icon: lamplit desk heaped with open journals, glowing flasks and scribbled anatomical diagrams

tal_nur_distillation.description: Copper tubing coiled in the back room, a slow drip into a clean jar. The revenue men assume bootlegging; she is only making things pure.
tal_nur_distillation.icon: copper coil condenser dripping clear liquid into a mason jar, warm amber glow

tal_nur_quiet_reagent.description: Colourless, odourless, slow to act. By the time the hive notices what she gave it, she is already across the room tending somebody else.
tal_nur_quiet_reagent.icon: plain clear vial half-hidden in a white nurse's apron pocket, faint shimmer

tal_nur_lethal_dosage.description: The same pharmacopoeia that tells her how to save a man lists, a page later, how much would kill one. She keeps that page dog-eared.
tal_nur_lethal_dosage.icon: skull-marked cobalt poison bottle resting on a thick open pharmacopoeia, candlelight

tal_nur_gas_gas_quick.description: The shout every soldier knew from Flanders, the fumbling for masks, the green cloud rolling in low. Now it is the bugs who fumble.
tal_nur_gas_gas_quick.icon: green chlorine cloud rolling over insect silhouettes, canvas gas mask in the foreground

tal_nur_hazmat_gloves.description: Thick red rubber to the elbow, the kind the surgeons at County General swear by. Acid, ichor and broken glass all slide right off.
tal_nur_hazmat_gloves.icon: red rubber surgical glove raised, green insect ichor dripping off it harmlessly

tal_pow_nitrate_stock.description: Old nitrate film burns hotter than anything in the prop room. A few feet of last year's picture makes a cheaper flash than store-bought powder.
tal_pow_nitrate_stock.icon: a curl of amber nitrate film strip catching fire, blinding white flash at its tip

tal_pow_blind_eye.description: A powder man breathes easier when the fire marshal is looking the other way, and a two-bit cigar keeps him looking.
tal_pow_blind_eye.icon: a fire marshal's peaked cap tipped over closed eyes, cigar smoke curling upward

tal_pow_cheap_fuse.description: Five-and-dime safety fuse from a hardware store on Cahuenga. It sputters and stinks, but it burns down just the same.
tal_pow_cheap_fuse.icon: a coil of cheap black fuse sputtering orange sparks on a scarred workbench

tal_pow_hot_lamps.description: Ten hours under the kliegs cooks a man's eyes and sharpens his wits. He learns what heat does to everything on a set.
tal_pow_hot_lamps.icon: a blazing klieg lamp glaring white, heat shimmer rolling off its iron housing

tal_pow_quick_draw.description: A squib wired fast is a squib wired cheap. The old hands do it by feel between takes, a cigarette still lit.
tal_pow_quick_draw.icon: quick hands twisting copper wire onto a small squib charge, blue sparks jumping

tal_pow_fire_watch.description: Somebody has to stand by the bucket while the set burns. The fire watch learns to stand close and not flinch.
tal_pow_fire_watch.icon: a red fire bucket held steady before a roaring wall of flame

tal_pow_celluloid_blaze.description: Celluloid goes up like a grudge held too long: fast, hot and impossible to put out. A pinch of it goes into everything you light.
tal_pow_celluloid_blaze.icon: a film canister bursting open, reels of celluloid erupting in orange flame

tal_pow_smouldering_reel.description: A reel left smouldering in its can is still burning when the projectionist comes back from lunch. So is whatever you lit.
tal_pow_smouldering_reel.icon: a dented film can leaking slow red embers and thin grey smoke

tal_pow_asbestos_gloves.description: Stiff grey mitts that smell of a boiler room. They have saved more fingers on Poverty Row than any union rule.
tal_pow_asbestos_gloves.icon: thick grey asbestos gloves gripping a red-hot iron bar, sparks scattering

tal_pow_burning_ambition.description: Every powder man dreams of the big one: the fall of Babylon, the Chicago fire. The dream keeps him reading chemistry books past midnight.
tal_pow_burning_ambition.icon: a lone candle flame swelling into a towering fireball above a chemistry book

tal_pow_nitrate_inferno.description: When a nitrate vault goes, it goes all at once, and no fire company in Los Angeles can stop it. You have learned to start one on purpose.
tal_pow_nitrate_inferno.icon: a steel vault door blown open, white-hot inferno roaring through shelves of film cans

tal_pow_final_reel.description: In the last reel, everything blows up. The audience expects it and the studio pays for it, so make the squibs count.
tal_pow_final_reel.icon: a projector reel spinning off its spindle in a shower of explosive sparks

tal_pow_gas_mask.description: The same rubber mask that saw you through Ypres. It still smells of chlorine, and it still keeps you breathing inside your own smoke.
tal_pow_gas_mask.icon: a battered rubber gas mask with round glass eyes, green smoke swirling past

tal_pow_cheap_smoke.description: A smoke pot is tar paper, saltpetre and a coffee can. The studio pays for the real thing and never asks questions.
tal_pow_cheap_smoke.icon: a battered coffee can belching thick grey smoke from a rag fuse

tal_pow_trench_coat.description: A khaki coat from the Somme, oiled and patched. It turned sleet in Flanders, and it turns a mandible well enough here.
tal_pow_trench_coat.icon: a mud-stained khaki trench coat, collar up, a fresh mandible gouge across the shoulder

tal_pow_no_mans_land.description: Anyone who crossed no man's land learned to move low and fast through smoke. The legs remember even when the man would rather not.
tal_pow_no_mans_land.icon: a crouching figure sprinting through drifting smoke past tangled barbed wire

tal_pow_smoke_signals.description: A few puffs in the right place tell the crew where you stand, and buy you a moment's rest behind the haze.
tal_pow_smoke_signals.icon: three rounded smoke puffs rising from a blanket lifted over a small fire

tal_pow_iron_lung.description: Years of breathing powder smoke on set have given you lungs like a Drinker respirator: tireless, wheezing and built of iron.
tal_pow_iron_lung.icon: a heavy iron bellows chest pumping hard, steam puffing from brass valves

tal_pow_smoke_and_mirrors.description: Half of Hollywood is smoke and the other half is mirrors. A tilted pane of glass doubles the cover for half the powder.
tal_pow_smoke_and_mirrors.icon: a tilted mirror reflecting a wall of white smoke, doubling it into the distance

tal_pow_lingering_haze.description: Your smoke hangs over the set like morning fog off the ocean, and the bugs blunder about in it long after it should have cleared.
tal_pow_lingering_haze.icon: low grey haze clinging to a studio street, giant insect silhouettes lost within

tal_pre_abstinence.description: Not a drop since the Volstead Act, and the body thanks you for it. Insect venom finds a sober constitution a poor host.
tal_pre_abstinence.icon: an overturned whiskey bottle draining into dry dirt beside a glowing glass of clear water

tal_pre_carries_hatchet.description: Carrie Nation took a hatchet to every saloon bar in Kansas. Her heirs find a carapace splits as nicely as polished mahogany.
tal_pre_carries_hatchet.icon: a small hatchet splitting a wooden saloon bar, splinters and broken glass flying

tal_pre_noble_experiment.description: Mr. Hoover called Prohibition a noble experiment. Whatever the bootleggers say, a blessing given bone-dry holds up well against claws.
tal_pre_noble_experiment.icon: a padlocked whiskey barrel wrapped in soft white protective light

tal_pre_pure_water.description: Hands scrubbed in clean Hollywood Reservoir water before they touch the wounded. Mr. Mulholland's water was always good for something.
tal_pre_pure_water.icon: cupped hands pouring clear glowing water over a bandaged forearm

tal_pre_pulpit_thumper.description: A man who pounds the lectern learns his scripture cold: chapter, verse, and the passages the bishop prefers to skip.
tal_pre_pulpit_thumper.icon: a fist slamming down on an oak pulpit, dust and Bible pages jumping

tal_pre_two_bit_sermon.description: Short, cheap and to the point. The best street-corner preachers on Vine can damn a sinner before the red car passes.
tal_pre_two_bit_sermon.icon: a silver quarter spinning on an open Bible, faint orange fire glow

tal_pre_wages_of_sin.description: The wages of sin is death, says Romans. The hive has been running up a tab since the Dome came down.
tal_pre_wages_of_sin.icon: a paper pay envelope bursting into flame, coins scattering from it

tal_pre_fiery_tongue.description: The words come easier when you mean every one of them. A rebuke from the heart costs the preacher little and the bug plenty.
tal_pre_fiery_tongue.icon: an open shouting mouth breathing a curling tongue of orange flame

tal_pre_hard_pew.description: Forty years of Sunday mornings on unpadded oak build a constitution. Nothing the invaders spit compares to a three-hour August revival.
tal_pre_hard_pew.icon: a worn wooden church pew glowing faintly, a snapped insect claw on the floor

tal_pre_thunder_pulpit.description: Some voices need no radio station. This one rattles the stained glass in the back row and lifts the spirit with it.
tal_pre_thunder_pulpit.icon: an empty pulpit under storm clouds, lightning crackling down around it

tal_pre_old_testament.description: Leave the gentle parables for peacetime. Plagues, locusts and fire from heaven speak more plainly to things with six legs.
tal_pre_old_testament.icon: an ancient scroll unrolling as burning locusts swarm out of its flames

tal_pre_trench_faith.description: Plenty of men found God in a shell hole in the Argonne. He kept them breathing then, and some swear He's doing it again.
tal_pre_trench_faith.icon: a dented doughboy helmet resting on a Bible in a muddy trench, softly glowing

tal_pre_sulphur_ration.description: A little brimstone with the morning coffee, so to speak. The preacher's fire banks overnight and is roaring again by breakfast.
tal_pre_sulphur_ration.icon: a tin mess cup steaming yellow sulphur smoke over a small camp fire

tal_pre_billy_sunday.description: Billy Sunday quit the Chicago White Stockings to slide into pulpits head-first. Preach his way and the rebuke lands like a fastball.
tal_pre_billy_sunday.icon: a flaming baseball streaking toward a giant insect head, motion trails

tal_pre_hellfire_damnation.description: The full revival-tent treatment: sawdust trail, brimstone and a voice that cracks plaster. No bug comes forward to be saved.
tal_pre_hellfire_damnation.icon: a canvas revival tent erupting with pillars of hellfire against a night sky

tal_pre_slow_burn.description: A good sermon doesn't end at the amen. It smoulders under the shell for hours, like a cigarette tossed into dry hill brush.
tal_pre_slow_burn.icon: glowing embers creeping along a cracked insect carapace, thin smoke rising

tal_pre_sawdust_trail.description: Every sinner who ever walked the sawdust trail to the mourner's bench left the preacher a little wiser about the human heart.
tal_pre_sawdust_trail.icon: a trail of fresh sawdust leading down a tent aisle toward a glowing altar rail

tal_pre_faith_healing.description: The pile of crutches by the platform tells the story. Call it the Lord or call it nerve, the cuts still close.
tal_pre_faith_healing.icon: a pair of wooden crutches cast aside on boards, golden light pouring over them

tal_pre_second_collection.description: When the plate comes back light, a seasoned preacher sends it round again and makes the hymn last on whatever the faithful can spare.
tal_pre_second_collection.icon: a brass collection plate heaped with nickels and pennies, glinting in candlelight

tal_pre_big_tent.description: Canvas big enough for the whole county, and room under it for every bruised soul who wanders in off the road.
tal_pre_big_tent.icon: a huge striped revival tent glowing from within at night, crowd silhouettes at the flap

tal_pre_radio_ministry.description: KFSG carries the Word clear across the Dome. A voice that steady is hard to shake, chittering hive or no.
tal_pre_radio_ministry.icon: a tall radio transmitter tower crackling with blue waves against a dusk sky

tal_pre_circuit_rider.description: The old Methodist riders covered three counties on horseback. Their heirs cover Hollywood on foot, and nearly as quick.
tal_pre_circuit_rider.icon: a dusty horseman in a long coat galloping, Bible strapped to the saddle

tal_pre_hallelujah_moment.description: Sometimes the Spirit lands all at once, and the whole room shouts amen before the preacher has finished the sentence.
tal_pre_hallelujah_moment.icon: two raised hands bursting with radiant white light, sparks flying upward

tal_pre_sunday_best.description: Pressed collar, shined shoes, hat brushed. A preacher who dresses the part spends less breath convincing the room.
tal_pre_sunday_best.icon: a crisp white clerical collar and black coat on a hanger, gleaming

tal_pre_soup_kitchen.description: With breadlines round the block, a preacher learns to make a little go a long way, whether it's soup or salvation.
tal_pre_soup_kitchen.icon: a steaming ladle lifting soup from a dented pot, a loaf of bread beside

tal_pre_altar_call.description: The organ swells, the lights come down, and the hurting come forward to the rail, where the preacher meets them with both hands.
tal_pre_altar_call.icon: a kneeling figure at a wooden altar rail under a single shaft of light

tal_pre_angelus_temple.description: Five thousand seats and a radio tower in Echo Park. Something of that great white blaze travels with every preacher who ever sang there.
tal_pre_angelus_temple.icon: the white domed Angelus Temple lit by floodlights, glowing cross atop the dome

tal_pre_testimony.description: Stand before the congregation and tell what the Lord pulled you out of. After that, a bug bite seems a small thing.
tal_pre_testimony.icon: a man standing at a pew, hand on heart, a spotlight falling on him

tal_pre_soda_fountain.description: A cherry phosphate at the corner drugstore does everything a shot of rye once did, and the preacher is the first to say so.
tal_pre_soda_fountain.icon: a fizzing soda glass with a straw on a marble counter, bubbles rising

tal_pre_sober_judgement.description: A clear-eyed man wastes nothing. He gives his blessing where it is needed and not a drop more.
tal_pre_sober_judgement.icon: a balanced brass scale with a small Bible on one pan, crisp light

tal_pre_volstead_act.description: The law of the land since 1920, and the preacher wears it like a breastplate, whatever the bootleggers think of it.
tal_pre_volstead_act.icon: a thick bound federal law book strapped to a forearm like a shield, rivets gleaming

tal_pre_bone_dry.description: Not a drop since the Armistice. Twelve years of clean living builds a constitution the hive can't easily chew through.
tal_pre_bone_dry.icon: an empty whiskey bottle upended in cracked desert dirt, sun-bleached and dry

tal_pre_clear_head.description: No Monday-morning fog, no shakes. The preacher reads the room and the Scripture sharper than any drinking man ever could.
tal_pre_clear_head.icon: a glass of clear water catching sunlight, throwing sharp prism rays

tal_pre_water_wagon.description: Once you climb aboard the water wagon you learn to keep your balance, and to step lively when something lunges.
tal_pre_water_wagon.icon: a horse-drawn water wagon with sloshing barrels, a figure leaping clear

tal_pre_padlock_order.description: The dry agents chain a speakeasy shut in a minute flat. The preacher learns to slam the fear of God on a thing just as fast.
tal_pre_padlock_order.icon: a heavy iron padlock snapping shut on a chained speakeasy door

tal_pre_temperance_union.description: The ladies of the WCTU still meet Tuesdays, Dome or no Dome, and they send their preacher out with bandages rolled tight.
tal_pre_temperance_union.icon: a white ribbon bow pinned beside neatly rolled bandages, soft glow

tal_nur_cheap_gauze.description: She buys gauze by the bolt from a Poverty Row wardrobe department and cuts it on her knee. It holds a wound as well as anything from Johns Hopkins.
tal_nur_cheap_gauze.icon: a bolt of white gauze unrolling across a knee, scissors mid-snip, warm lamplight

tal_nur_cool_head.description: She has stood in a field hospital while the guns walked closer. A bug the size of a Ford sedan does not rattle her.
tal_nur_cool_head.icon: a nurse's calm profile under a starched cap, huge insect shadow looming behind, cool blue glow

tal_nur_steady_hands.description: Her hands do not shake. Not for shellfire, not for ichor, not for a stuntman hollering about his collarbone.
tal_nur_steady_hands.icon: two steady hands drawing a curved suture needle, thread gleaming against a dark background

tal_nur_cheap_ammonia.description: Household ammonia from the corner drugstore, decanted into little brown bottles. It wakes a man just as rudely as the expensive kind.
tal_nur_cheap_ammonia.icon: a small brown smelling-salts bottle uncorked, sharp white vapour curling upward

tal_nur_second_wind.description: Somewhere past the third casualty she stops feeling tired and simply keeps going, the way she did at Étaples in the spring of 1918.
tal_nur_second_wind.icon: a nurse's cape billowing as a fresh gust of pale light sweeps through

tal_nur_hard_floor_sleeper.description: Ten minutes on bare linoleum between patients and she is up again. The Roosevelt Hotel's feather beds would only spoil her.
tal_nur_hard_floor_sleeper.icon: a folded wool blanket on bare floorboards, nurse's cap resting on top, dim lamp

tal_nur_casualty_clearing.description: She sets up where the wounded fall: a tarpaulin, a lantern, two sawhorses and a door. It worked in Flanders and it works on Vine Street.
tal_nur_casualty_clearing.icon: a canvas tent with a red cross glowing in lantern light, stretchers lined outside

tal_nur_trench_constitution.description: Mud, lice, cold bully beef and trench fever. Anyone who came through all that is not about to be finished off by an insect.
tal_nur_trench_constitution.icon: a battered mud-spattered tin helmet with a red cross band, steam rising

tal_nur_brisk_rounds.description: Rubber soles squeak down the ward at a pace just shy of running. Head nurses have been timed against Charley Paddock and won.
tal_nur_brisk_rounds.icon: white rubber-soled nurse's shoes mid-stride on polished linoleum, motion blur

tal_nur_stretcher_bearer.description: She learned more medicine carrying the stretcher than she ever did in lectures. You watch a man's face the whole way back.
tal_nur_stretcher_bearer.icon: a canvas field stretcher carried through smoke by two silhouettes, red cross armband bright

tal_nur_angel_of_mons.description: In 1914 the Tommies swore they saw angels over Mons. The boys she dragged off the Paramount lot swear they saw her.
tal_nur_angel_of_mons.icon: a radiant winged nurse silhouette above a battlefield, golden light breaking through smoke

tal_nur_clean_sheets.description: Boiled white, starched stiff, corners square enough to cut yourself on. Nothing creeps into a bed she has made.
tal_nur_clean_sheets.icon: a crisp white hospital sheet snapping in the air, faint protective shimmer along its edge

tal_nur_house_calls.description: She keeps a bicycle and a black bag by the door, and she knows which porch lights on Gower mean trouble.
tal_nur_house_calls.icon: a black medical bag in a bicycle basket, porch light glowing at night

tal_nur_cod_liver_oil.description: A spoonful every morning, whether you like it or not. Nobody likes it. It comes cheap by the case and lasts forever.
tal_nur_cod_liver_oil.icon: a silver spoon brimming with golden cod liver oil, glinting bottle behind

tal_nur_doctors_orders.description: The doctor writes the order; she sees it carried out to the letter. Patients find it easier to argue with the bugs.
tal_nur_doctors_orders.icon: a fountain pen signing a prescription pad, ink glistening, stethoscope coiled beside

tal_nur_chloroform_calm.description: She moves through a fight like a ward at midnight, soft-footed and unhurried, and the hive's attention slides right past her.
tal_nur_chloroform_calm.icon: a chloroform-soaked cloth trailing a faint lavender haze beside a tipped amber bottle

tal_nur_sterile_field.description: Carbolic on every surface, instruments boiled, hands scrubbed to the elbow. Done properly, everything she touches goes exactly where she means it.
tal_nur_sterile_field.icon: surgical instruments gleaming in a steaming enamel tray, carbolic vapour rising

tal_nur_quiet_ward.description: Lights low, curtains drawn, a radio murmuring dance music at the far end. The patients mend faster, and so does she.
tal_nur_quiet_ward.icon: a dim ward of white iron beds, a single lamp glowing softly at the far end

tal_nur_bedside_vigil.description: She sits up all night in a hard chair with her cap still pinned. Whatever comes for the patient has to come past her first.
tal_nur_bedside_vigil.icon: a wooden chair beside an iron bed, a nurse's lantern burning steady through the dark

tal_nur_laudanum_drip.description: A few drops in a glass of water, the old remedy. Not strictly legal, but nobody under the Dome is asking to see her license.
tal_nur_laudanum_drip.icon: an amber laudanum bottle with glass dropper, a single golden drop falling into water

tal_mec_steel_helmet.description: A dented tin hat from the Argonne, bought for two bits off a Legion man. It rang like a church bell the first time a mandible found it.
tal_mec_steel_helmet.icon: a dented olive-drab Brodie steel helmet deflecting a black insect claw, sparks flying

tal_mec_iron_constitution.description: Twenty years of foundry smoke, bad coffee and worse landlords. A man built like that does not fold because a bug the size of a Ford leans on him.
tal_mec_iron_constitution.icon: a riveted cast-iron boiler plate over a beating heart, glowing red at the seams

tal_mec_demolition_man.description: Drive the pile hard and drive it true. The wreckers on Vine swear a good pile driver splits a hive wall like kindling.
tal_mec_demolition_man.icon: a steel pile driver slamming down, cracking green hive resin into flying shards

tal_mec_sweatshop_pace.description: Ten-hour shifts on a rivet line teach a body to keep moving. Breaks are for the front office.
tal_mec_sweatshop_pace.icon: a factory punch clock with its hands spinning in a blur, steam rising

tal_mec_field_dressing.description: Clean rag, iodine and a strip of friction tape. Not pretty, but it holds until somebody with a proper bag comes along.
tal_mec_field_dressing.icon: a bloodied bandage wound tight with black friction tape around a muscled forearm

tal_mec_sandbag_walls.description: Sandbags stacked shoulder-high across Highland, the way the boys did it in France. Bugs chew through most things, but not burlap full of beach.
tal_mec_sandbag_walls.icon: stacked burlap sandbags under a hail of insect spines, dust bursting outward

tal_mec_cheap_bandages.description: Torn bedsheets from the Roosevelt Hotel, boiled in a washtub out back. The management has not yet sent a bill.
tal_mec_cheap_bandages.icon: torn white bedsheet strips steaming over a dented tin washtub

tal_mec_foremans_glare.description: The look that once kept a whole grip crew off the lunch wagon. It works on hive drones too, near enough.
tal_mec_foremans_glare.icon: hard narrowed eyes under a flat cap brim, glaring with a red glow

tal_mec_sidestep_shuffle.description: Learned dodging swinging flats and runaway dollies on a soundstage floor. A pincer is slower than a falling sandbag, mostly.
tal_mec_sidestep_shuffle.icon: scuffed work boots sidestepping on a stage floor, an insect pincer snapping empty air

tal_mec_quick_fix.description: Spit, wire and a sharp rap with the heel of the hand. Half the radios in Hollywood run on the same principle.
tal_mec_quick_fix.icon: a hand slapping a sputtering patch kit, a blue spark leaping from it

tal_mec_factory_recall.description: Every overhaul goes back to the book: original drawings, original tolerances. What the factory built, a careful man can build again.
tal_mec_factory_recall.icon: a glowing blue blueprint beneath a steel bolt being torqued down by a wrench

tal_mec_lunch_pail.description: Two ham sandwiches, a boiled egg and coffee in the lid. Enough to carry a working man through a double shift on the barricades.
tal_mec_lunch_pail.icon: a dented tin lunch pail flung open, steam curling from the coffee lid

tal_mec_spit_and_polish.description: A tidy bench and oiled tools keep a man's head clear. Wipe the wrench, wipe the brow, breathe.
tal_mec_spit_and_polish.icon: a gleaming wrench being polished with an oily rag, a bright star of glint

tal_mec_warranty_work.description: Guaranteed for ninety days or ninety bugs, whichever comes first. The shop stands behind its work and does not charge twice.
tal_mec_warranty_work.icon: a brass guarantee tag on wire hanging from a freshly repaired steel gear

tal_mec_good_as_new.description: When the job is done the plating sits flush and the man inside it stands straight. You would never know a bug had chewed either.
tal_mec_good_as_new.icon: a freshly riveted steel chest plate gleaming, the last rivet still glowing hot

tal_mec_wrench_parry.description: A two-foot Stillson wrench turns a stinger as well as any cavalry sabre, and costs a good deal less.
tal_mec_wrench_parry.icon: a heavy Stillson wrench knocking aside a barbed insect stinger, sparks flying

tal_mec_fine_calibration.description: A turn of the jeweller's screwdriver and a squint through the loupe, and every contraption in the kit hits a hair closer to where it hurts.
tal_mec_fine_calibration.icon: a tiny screwdriver adjusting a brass gauge needle, glinting under a hot work lamp

tal_mec_thrown_spanner.description: A good mechanic never walks to fetch a wrench back. He throws it, and the hive learns to duck.
tal_mec_thrown_spanner.icon: a steel spanner spinning end over end toward an insect head, motion blur

tal_mec_bootleg_current.description: Wire tapped straight off the Pacific Electric overhead. The welder runs hot and the power company never sends a bill.
tal_mec_bootleg_current.icon: alligator clips biting a red-car trolley wire, sparks raining down onto a welding torch

tal_mec_tack_strip.description: Roofing tacks and carpet nails, swept into a coffee can and flung by the handful. Cheap as dirt and twice as mean.
tal_mec_tack_strip.icon: a dented coffee can spilling bright roofing tacks across wet cobblestones

tal_mec_union_battery.description: A wet-cell battery stamped with the IATSE local's number. Union-made, union-charged, and it keeps a man going well past quitting time.
tal_mec_union_battery.icon: a glass-jar wet-cell battery glowing blue, copper terminals crackling with sparks

tal_mec_patent_pending.description: The wrench has been filed, reshaped and improved past recognition. The Patent Office has three letters about it and has answered none.
tal_mec_patent_pending.icon: a strangely modified monkey wrench lying on blueprints beside a glowing red wax seal

tal_mec_short_circuit.description: Bare copper threaded through the tacks. A bug that steps down gets a nail in the foot and a jolt clean up the leg.
tal_mec_short_circuit.icon: scattered caltrops linked by bare copper wire, blue sparks leaping between the points

tal_mec_roller_skates.description: Borrowed from the grips who use them to cross the big stages. Nobody looks dignified on them, but everybody arrives first.
tal_mec_roller_skates.icon: a pair of steel-wheeled roller skates racing forward, sparks trailing from the wheels

tal_mec_edisons_spite.description: The Wizard of Menlo Park swore by perspiration. The mechanic adds one part plain meanness, and every blow lands sorer for it.
tal_mec_edisons_spite.icon: a glowing carbon-filament bulb clenched in a grease-blackened fist, sparks flying

tal_mec_monkey_business.description: The monkey wrench comes round with a little extra English on it, the kind a man learns working nights on Poverty Row.
tal_mec_monkey_business.icon: a heavy monkey wrench swinging in a wide arc, green ichor spraying from its jaws

tal_mec_tesla_coil.description: The welder's arc jumps its gap and crawls up the bug like lightning down a church spire. Mr. Tesla would have enjoyed the show.
tal_mec_tesla_coil.icon: a welding torch throwing a forked violet arc into a giant insect's carapace

tal_mec_asbestos_gloves.description: Fireproof mitts from the effects shop, stiff as cardboard and thick as a porterhouse. A mantis claw finds precious little to bite.
tal_mec_asbestos_gloves.icon: thick grey asbestos gloves catching a flaming insect claw, embers scattering

tal_mec_shell_shock.description: A ringing blow to the carapace leaves the thing staggered and stupid, like a doughboy after a whizz-bang landed close.
tal_mec_shell_shock.icon: a sledgehammer striking an insect carapace, shockwave rings and cracks spreading outward

tal_mec_lead_pipe.description: Plumber's lead pipe weighs more than it looks and asks less of the arm. The dime-novel detectives were right about it.
tal_mec_lead_pipe.icon: a dull grey lead pipe swung hard, cracking an insect mandible, motion streaks

tal_mec_ten_mile_march.description: Camp Kearny taught him to walk ten miles under a full pack and complain the whole way. The legs remember, whether he likes it or not.
tal_mec_ten_mile_march.icon: muddy army boots with wrapped puttees marching down a dusty road, dust rising

tal_mec_pick_handle_parry.description: An ash pick handle, held crosswise like a quarterstaff, turns aside a claw the same way it once turned aside a picket-line cop.
tal_mec_pick_handle_parry.icon: a wooden pick handle held crosswise, blocking a striking insect claw, splinters flying

tal_mec_union_rates.description: The pile driver comes down for a fair day's wage and not a penny over. The local's business agent would approve.
tal_mec_union_rates.icon: a steel pile driver ram slamming down, dust and green ichor bursting outward

tal_mec_coffee_cigarettes.description: Black coffee from a thermos lid and a Lucky Strike behind the ear. The second wind comes quicker than any doctor would advise.
tal_mec_coffee_cigarettes.icon: a steaming tin thermos cup beside a smouldering cigarette on a toolbox lid

tal_mec_lights_out.description: Laid in just behind the antennae, the monkey wrench puts a bug to sleep quicker and cheaper than any bouncer on the Strip.
tal_mec_lights_out.icon: a monkey wrench connecting with an insect's skull, its glowing eyes dimming out

tal_mec_over_the_top.description: When the whistle blew in France, a man climbed the ladder and ran. The legs and the nerve both came home with him.
tal_mec_over_the_top.icon: a figure vaulting a sandbag parapet, hammer raised, flare light burning behind
